index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d0897d7320daa10d06c18fd65dc9e16285f8ea5a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }
+
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any {
+	if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok { return m }
+	return nil
+}
+func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string {
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []string: return x
+	case []any:
+		out := make([]string, 0, len(x)); for _, v := range x { if s, ok := v.(string); ok { out = append(out,s) } }; return out
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func hook(config map[string]any, name string) any { return mapping(config["hooks"])[name] }
+func moduleHook(module project.Module, name string) any { return mapping(module.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name] }
+
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
+func expandOnce(s string, values map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+	var b strings.Builder
+	for i:=0;i<len(s); {
+		if s[i]=='{' { if j:=strings.IndexByte(s[i:], '}'); j>=0 { key:=s[i+1:i+j]; if value,ok:=values[key];ok { if shell { value=shellQuote(value) }; b.WriteString(value); i+=j+1; continue } } }
+		b.WriteByte(s[i]); i++
+	}
+	return b.String()
+}
+func commandArgs(command any, values map[string]string) ([]string,error) {
+	switch x:=command.(type) {
+	case string:
+		if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook command") }
+		return []string{"sh","-c",expandOnce(x,values,true)},nil
+	case []string:
+		if len(x)==0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv") }; out:=make([]string,len(x)); for i,s:=range x {out[i]=expandOnce(s,values,false)}; return out,nil
+	case []any:
+		if len(x)==0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv") }; out:=make([]string,len(x)); for i,v:=range x { s,ok:=v.(string);if !ok{return nil,fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};out[i]=expandOnce(s,values,false)};return out,nil
+	default: return nil,fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T",command)
+	}
+}
+type processResult struct { stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error }
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, root string, args []string, env map[string]string) processResult {
+	if timeout<=0 { timeout=3*time.Minute }
+	ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout); defer cancel()
+	if len(args)==0 || args[0]=="" { return processResult{err:fmt.Errorf("empty command")} }
+	cmd:=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...);cmd.Dir=root
+	cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+	cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+	var out,errout bytes.Buffer;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+	if err:=cmd.Start();err!=nil{return processResult{err:err}}
+	done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+	var err error
+	select {case err=<-done: case <-ctx.Done(): _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL); <-done;err=ctx.Err()}
+	r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+	if err==nil {return r};if e,ok:=err.(*exec.ExitError);ok {r.exit=e.ExitCode();r.err=nil}
+	return r
+}
+func rootPath(root,p string) string { return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(p)) }

+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(module project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){section,_:=contracts.Section(module.Document.Body,"Specs");items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(section);if err!=nil {message:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message),"duplicate"){return nil,coded("C05","%s",message)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",message)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, request model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+	var module *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module{module=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+	if module==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",request.Module)}
+	specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*module);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+	selected:=moduleHook(*module,"eval");if selected==nil{selected=hook(request.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if selected==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",module.Name)}
+	f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+	values:=map[string]string{"module":module.Name,"module_dir":module.Dir,"report":reportPath}
+	args,err:=commandArgs(selected,values);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","eval hook: %v",err)}
+	result:=runCommand(ctx,request.Timeout,request.Snapshot.Root,args,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin})
+	report:=model.Report{HookExit:result.exit,Stdout:result.stdout,Stderr:result.stderr}
+	if result.err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",result.err)}
+	data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+	parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+	fails:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{fails=true;break}}
+	if (result.exit==0)==fails{return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",result.exit)}
+	return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+	snap:=request.Snapshot;var diags []project.Diagnostic;var first error
+	add:=func(code,msg,path string,warning bool){diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Message:msg,Path:path,Warning:warning});if !warning&&first==nil{first=coded(code,"%s",msg)}}
+	baseline:=map[string]bool{};if b,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));err==nil{for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(b),"\n"){if line!=""{baseline[line]=true}}}
+	optOut:=map[string]string{};for _,m:=range snap.Modules{reason:=strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]));if reason!=""{optOut[m.Name]=reason;add("X03",fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt-out: %s",m.Name,reason),m.Dir,true)}}
+	global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+	// The global hook applies to modules without an override; each override is run separately.
+	type group struct{command any; modules []project.Module; label string}
+	groups:=[]group{};var globalModules []project.Module
+	for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if local:=moduleHook(m,"boundaries");local!=nil{groups=append(groups,group{local,[]project.Module{m},m.Name})}else{globalModules=append(globalModules,m)}}
+	if global!=nil && len(globalModules)>0 {groups=append([]group{{global,globalModules,"global"}},groups...)}
+	for _,m:=range globalModules {if global==nil{if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&optOut[m.Name]==""{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s: missing boundaries hook",m.Name),m.Dir,false)}else{add("X04",fmt.Sprintf("%s: no boundary enforcement required",m.Name),m.Dir,true)}}}
+	for _,g:=range groups {
+		values:=map[string]string{};if len(g.modules)==1{values["module"]=g.modules[0].Name;values["module_dir"]=g.modules[0].Dir}
+		args,err:=commandArgs(g.command,values);if err!=nil{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",g.label,err),"",false);continue}
+		r:=runCommand(ctx,request.Timeout,snap.Root,args,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin})
+		if r.err!=nil{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",g.label,r.err),"",false);continue}
+		for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line]{continue};moduleName:="";for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":"){moduleName=m.Name;break}};if moduleName!=""&&optOut[moduleName]!=""{continue};add("X01",line,"",false)}
+	}
+	return diags,first
+}
+
+var _ time.Duration

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d72751e42e0541fc2392bd68e870fdbbb75c5109

+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"fmt"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitDetail struct { Message string `xml:"message,attr"`; Body string `xml:",chardata"` }
+type junitCase struct { Name string `xml:"name,attr"`; Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`; Time string `xml:"time,attr"`; Failure []junitDetail `xml:"failure"`; Error []junitDetail `xml:"error"`; Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"` }
+type junitSuite struct { Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`; Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"` }
+type junitDocument struct { XMLName xml.Name; Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`; Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"` }
+
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report,error) {
+	var doc junitDocument
+	if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&doc);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+	if doc.XMLName.Local!="testsuite" && doc.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",doc.XMLName.Local)}
+	var cases []junitCase;cases=append(cases,doc.Cases...)
+	var collect func(junitSuite);collect=func(s junitSuite){cases=append(cases,s.Cases...);for _,child:=range s.Suites{collect(child)}}
+	for _,suite:=range doc.Suites{collect(suite)}
+	report:=model.Report{}
+	for _,c:=range cases {
+		ids:=[]string{};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname){ids=append(ids,s.ID)}}
+		if len(ids)==0 {
+			// Distinguish an apparent but unknown ID from a testcase with no ID at all.
+			for _,part:=range strings.FieldsFunc(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,func(r rune)bool{return !(r>='A'&&r<='Z'||r>='a'&&r<='z'||r>='0'&&r<='9'||r=='-'||r=='_')}) {
+				candidate:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(part,"_",""))
+				for _,s:=range specs {prefix:=strings.SplitN(s.ID,"-",2)[0];if strings.HasPrefix(candidate,prefix) && len(candidate)>len(prefix) {return model.Report{},coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,part)}}
+			}
+			return model.Report{},coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)
+		}
+		seconds,_:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);result:="pass";failure:=""
+		if len(c.Failure)+len(c.Error)>0 {result="fail";var details []string;for _,d:=range append(c.Failure,c.Error...) {if m:=strings.TrimSpace(d.Message);m!=""{details=append(details,m)};if b:=strings.TrimSpace(d.Body);b!=""{details=append(details,b)}};failure=strings.Join(details,"\n") } else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {result="skip"}
+		report.Cases=append(report.Cases,model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,IDs:ids,Result:result,Failure:failure,Seconds:seconds});report.Seconds+=seconds
+	}
+	return report,nil
+}
+func hasID(c model.Case,id string) bool {for _,x:=range c.IDs{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func exempt(tag string)bool {t:=strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag));return t=="review"||strings.HasPrefix(t,"quarantine")}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {for _,s:=range specs {if exempt(s.Tag){continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c,s.ID){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report,ids,already []string)error {done:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range already{done[id]=true};for _,id:=range ids{if done[id]{continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs{tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result!="fail"{continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs{if tag,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(tag),"quarantine"){return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s: %s",c.Name,id,fmt.Sprint(c.Failure))}}};return nil}

+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"path"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func matches(patterns []string,p string)bool{for _,pattern:=range patterns{if contracts.MatchGlob(pattern,p){return true}};return false}
+func inModule(p,dir string)bool{return p==dir||strings.HasPrefix(p,strings.TrimSuffix(dir,"/")+"/")}
+func moduleRelative(p,dir string)string{return strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(p,dir),"/")}
+func isProtected(p string, snap project.Snapshot)bool{return p==".fireweed"||strings.HasPrefix(p,".fireweed/")||matches(stringsValue(snap.Config["protected"]),p)}
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest)[]project.Diagnostic{
+	var out []project.Diagnostic
+	var target *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module{target=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+	check:=func(p,status string){p=path.Clean(strings.TrimPrefix(p,"./"));reject:=func(reason string){out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:p,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s",p,reason)})}
+		if isProtected(p,request.Snapshot){reject("protected path");return}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/") {if p!=path.Clean(request.ChangePath){reject("other change file")};return}
+		if request.Phase=="audit"{reject("audit may edit only current change");return}
+		for _,m:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if inModule(p,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=request.Module{reject("other module");return}}
+		if target==nil||!inModule(p,target.Dir){if !matches(stringsValue(request.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),p){reject("outside worker writable paths")};return}
+		rel:=moduleRelative(p,target.Dir);if rel=="SPEC.md"{reject("module SPEC.md");return}
+		zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+		if request.Phase=="evals" {switch zone {case "protected","preserve","append_only":reject("zone frozen during evals");case "interface":if !request.InterfaceDeclared{reject("interface not declared")};case "disposable":if existsAtBase(request.Snapshot.Root,request.Base,p){reject("existing disposable file")}};return}
+		if request.Phase=="impl" {switch zone{case "protected","evals","interface":reject("zone frozen during impl");case "append_only":if status!="A"||existsAtBase(request.Snapshot.Root,request.Base,p){reject("append-only existing file")}};return}
+		reject("unknown phase")
+	}
+	for _,c:=range request.Changes{if c.OldPath!=""{check(c.OldPath,c.Status)};check(c.Path,c.Status)}
+	return out
+}
+func existsAtBase(root,revision,p string)bool{if revision==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,p);return err==nil}

+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"

+)
+
+func gitOutput(root string,args ...string)(string,error){cmd:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);out,err:=cmd.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(out)))};return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)),nil}
+func gitPaths(root,revision string)([]string,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",revision);if err!=nil{return nil,err};if out==""{return nil,nil};return strings.Split(out,"\n"),nil}
+func recordedChanges(root,revision string)(map[string]contracts.Document,error){paths,err:=gitPaths(root,revision);if err!=nil{return nil,err};changes:=map[string]contracts.Document{};for _,p:=range paths{if !strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")||!strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){continue};data,err:=gitOutput(root,"show",revision+":"+p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(data);if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("%s at %s: %w",p,revision,err)};changes[p]=doc};return changes,nil}
+func changeIdentity(p string)string{return path.Base(p)}
+func priorChange(changes map[string]contracts.Document,p string)(contracts.Document,bool){if doc,ok:=changes[p];ok{return doc,true};for old,doc:=range changes{if changeIdentity(old)==changeIdentity(p){return doc,true}};return contracts.Document{},false}
+func changedPaths(root,parent,commit string)(map[string]string,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,commit);if err!=nil{return nil,err};result:=map[string]string{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){parts:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(parts)<2{continue};status:=parts[0];if strings.HasPrefix(status,"R")||strings.HasPrefix(status,"C"){if len(parts)>2{result[parts[1]]="D";result[parts[2]]="A"}}else{result[parts[1]]=status}};return result,nil}
+func combinedPaths(root,commit string)(map[string]bool,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"show","--cc","--format=","--name-only",commit);if err!=nil{return nil,err};paths:=map[string]bool{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){if p!=""{paths[p]=true}};return paths,nil}
+func zoneMatches(snap project.Snapshot,p string,selector func(contracts.Zones)[]string)bool{for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if inModule(p,m.Dir)&&matches(selector(m.Zones),moduleRelative(p,m.Dir)){return true}};return false}
+func projectedZones(snap project.Snapshot,change contracts.Document)project.Snapshot{
+	name:=stringValue(change.Frontmatter["module"]);set:=mapping(change.Frontmatter["set"]);if name==""||set==nil{return snap}
+	for i:=range snap.Modules{if snap.Modules[i].Name!=name{continue};z:=&snap.Modules[i].Zones
+		for key,value:=range set{v:=stringsValue(value);switch key{case "evals":z.Evals=v;case "interface":z.Interface=v;case "append_only":z.AppendOnly=v;case "protected":z.Protected=v;case "disposable":z.Disposable=v;case "preserve":z.Preserve=v}}
+	}
+	return snap
+}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){
+	result:=model.HistoryReport{}
+	if revisionRange==""{snap,err:=project.Load(root);if err!=nil{return result,err};base:=stringValue(snap.Config["base"]);if base==""{return result,fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")};resolved,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-parse",base);if err!=nil{return result,err};mergeBase,err:=gitOutput(root,"merge-base","HEAD",resolved);if err!=nil{return result,err};revisionRange=mergeBase+"..HEAD"}
+	list,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--reverse","--topo-order",revisionRange);if err!=nil{return result,err};if list==""{return result,nil};result.Commits=strings.Split(list,"\n")
+	for _,commit:=range result.Commits{
+		line,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};parents:=strings.Fields(line)[1:]
+		after,err:=project.LoadAt(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,fmt.Errorf("project at %s: %w",commit,err)}
+		afterChanges,err:=recordedChanges(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+		if len(parents)==0{continue}
+		before,err:=project.LoadAt(root,parents[0]);if err!=nil{return result,fmt.Errorf("project at %s: %w",parents[0],err)}
+		beforeChanges,err:=recordedChanges(root,parents[0]);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+		paths,err:=changedPaths(root,parents[0],commit);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+		if len(parents)>1 {combined,err:=combinedPaths(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};paths=map[string]string{};for p:=range combined{paths[p]="M"}}
+		worker:=false;appliedFromImpl:=false;squashed:=false;projectedBefore:=before;projectedAfter:=after
+		for p,doc:=range afterChanges{
+			phase:=stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]);if phase==""{continue}
+			old,ok:=priorChange(beforeChanges,p);oldPhase:=stringValue(old.Frontmatter["phase"])
+			if len(parents)>1{sameParent:=false;for _,parent:=range parents{pc,err:=recordedChanges(root,parent);if err!=nil{return result,err};if previous,found:=priorChange(pc,p);found&&stringValue(previous.Frontmatter["phase"])==phase{sameParent=true;break}};if sameParent{continue}}
+			if ok&&oldPhase==phase{continue};worker=true
+			if phase=="applied" {if oldPhase=="impl" {appliedFromImpl=true;projectedBefore=projectedZones(projectedBefore,old);projectedAfter=projectedZones(projectedAfter,doc)}else{squashed=true;result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:commit,Change:p})}}
+		}
+		add:=func(code,p string){result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:p,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s at %s",code,commit)})}
+		for p,status:=range paths{
+			if worker&&!squashed&&(isProtected(p,before)||isProtected(p,after)||zoneMatches(before,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Protected})||zoneMatches(after,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Protected})||strings.HasPrefix(p,".fireweed/playbooks/")){add("H01",p)}
+			if appliedFromImpl&&!squashed&&(zoneMatches(projectedBefore,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Evals})||zoneMatches(projectedBefore,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Interface})||zoneMatches(projectedAfter,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Evals})||zoneMatches(projectedAfter,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Interface})){add("H02",p)}
+			if status!="A"&&(zoneMatches(before,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.AppendOnly})||zoneMatches(after,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.AppendOnly})){add("H03",p)}
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/archive/")&&status!="A"&&status!="D"{add("H04",p)}
+		}
+	}
+	return result,nil
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a6340e56e62ebf8b34bc5f12f330dbdf3887564f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(module project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){section,_:=contracts.Section(module.Document.Body,"Specs");items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(section);if err!=nil {message:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message),"duplicate"){return nil,coded("C05","%s",message)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",message)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, request model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+	var module *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module{module=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+	if module==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",request.Module)}
+	specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*module);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+	selected:=moduleHook(*module,"eval");if selected==nil{selected=hook(request.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if selected==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",module.Name)}
+	f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+	values:=map[string]string{"module":module.Name,"module_dir":module.Dir,"report":reportPath}
+	args,err:=commandArgs(selected,values);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","eval hook: %v",err)}
+	result:=runCommand(ctx,request.Timeout,request.Snapshot.Root,args,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin})
+	report:=model.Report{HookExit:result.exit,Stdout:result.stdout,Stderr:result.stderr}
+	if result.err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",result.err)}
+	data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+	parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+	fails:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{fails=true;break}}
+	if (result.exit==0)==fails{return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",result.exit)}
+	return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+	snap:=request.Snapshot;var diags []project.Diagnostic;var first error
+	add:=func(code,msg,path string,warning bool){diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Message:msg,Path:path,Warning:warning});if !warning&&first==nil{first=coded(code,"%s",msg)}}
+	baseline:=map[string]bool{};if b,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));err==nil{for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(b),"\n"){if line!=""{baseline[line]=true}}}
+	optOut:=map[string]string{};for _,m:=range snap.Modules{reason:=strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]));if reason!=""{optOut[m.Name]=reason;add("X03",fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt-out: %s",m.Name,reason),m.Dir,true)}}
+	global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+	// The global hook applies to modules without an override; each override is run separately.
+	type group struct{command any; modules []project.Module; label string}
+	groups:=[]group{};var globalModules []project.Module
+	for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if local:=moduleHook(m,"boundaries");local!=nil{groups=append(groups,group{local,[]project.Module{m},m.Name})}else{globalModules=append(globalModules,m)}}
+	if global!=nil && len(globalModules)>0 {groups=append([]group{{global,globalModules,"global"}},groups...)}
+	for _,m:=range globalModules {if global==nil{if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&optOut[m.Name]==""{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s: missing boundaries hook",m.Name),m.Dir,false)}else{add("X04",fmt.Sprintf("%s: no boundary enforcement required",m.Name),m.Dir,true)}}}
+	for _,g:=range groups {
+		values:=map[string]string{};if len(g.modules)==1{values["module"]=g.modules[0].Name;values["module_dir"]=g.modules[0].Dir}
+		args,err:=commandArgs(g.command,values);if err!=nil{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",g.label,err),"",false);continue}
+		r:=runCommand(ctx,request.Timeout,snap.Root,args,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin})
+		if r.err!=nil{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",g.label,r.err),"",false);continue}
+		for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line]{continue};moduleName:="";for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":"){moduleName=m.Name;break}};if moduleName!=""&&optOut[moduleName]!=""{continue};add("X01",line,"",false)}
+	}
+	return diags,first
+}
+

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d72751e42e0541fc2392bd68e870fdbbb75c5109
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"fmt"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitDetail struct { Message string `xml:"message,attr"`; Body string `xml:",chardata"` }
+type junitCase struct { Name string `xml:"name,attr"`; Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`; Time string `xml:"time,attr"`; Failure []junitDetail `xml:"failure"`; Error []junitDetail `xml:"error"`; Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"` }
+type junitSuite struct { Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`; Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"` }
+type junitDocument struct { XMLName xml.Name; Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`; Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"` }
+
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report,error) {
+	var doc junitDocument
+	if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&doc);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+	if doc.XMLName.Local!="testsuite" && doc.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",doc.XMLName.Local)}
+	var cases []junitCase;cases=append(cases,doc.Cases...)
+	var collect func(junitSuite);collect=func(s junitSuite){cases=append(cases,s.Cases...);for _,child:=range s.Suites{collect(child)}}
+	for _,suite:=range doc.Suites{collect(suite)}
+	report:=model.Report{}
+	for _,c:=range cases {
+		ids:=[]string{};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname){ids=append(ids,s.ID)}}
+		if len(ids)==0 {
+			// Distinguish an apparent but unknown ID from a testcase with no ID at all.
+			for _,part:=range strings.FieldsFunc(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,func(r rune)bool{return !(r>='A'&&r<='Z'||r>='a'&&r<='z'||r>='0'&&r<='9'||r=='-'||r=='_')}) {
+				candidate:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(part,"_",""))
+				for _,s:=range specs {prefix:=strings.SplitN(s.ID,"-",2)[0];if strings.HasPrefix(candidate,prefix) && len(candidate)>len(prefix) {return model.Report{},coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,part)}}
+			}
+			return model.Report{},coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)
+		}
+		seconds,_:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);result:="pass";failure:=""
+		if len(c.Failure)+len(c.Error)>0 {result="fail";var details []string;for _,d:=range append(c.Failure,c.Error...) {if m:=strings.TrimSpace(d.Message);m!=""{details=append(details,m)};if b:=strings.TrimSpace(d.Body);b!=""{details=append(details,b)}};failure=strings.Join(details,"\n") } else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {result="skip"}
+		report.Cases=append(report.Cases,model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,IDs:ids,Result:result,Failure:failure,Seconds:seconds});report.Seconds+=seconds
+	}
+	return report,nil
+}
+func hasID(c model.Case,id string) bool {for _,x:=range c.IDs{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func exempt(tag string)bool {t:=strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag));return t=="review"||strings.HasPrefix(t,"quarantine")}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {for _,s:=range specs {if exempt(s.Tag){continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c,s.ID){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report,ids,already []string)error {done:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range already{done[id]=true};for _,id:=range ids{if done[id]{continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs{tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result!="fail"{continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs{if tag,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(tag),"quarantine"){return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s: %s",c.Name,id,fmt.Sprint(c.Failure))}}};return nil}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cb03b9461cbcd24b3eaed28dda6bd96f62241a50
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"path"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func matches(patterns []string,p string)bool{for _,pattern:=range patterns{if contracts.MatchGlob(pattern,p){return true}};return false}
+func inModule(p,dir string)bool{return p==dir||strings.HasPrefix(p,strings.TrimSuffix(dir,"/")+"/")}
+func moduleRelative(p,dir string)string{return strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(p,dir),"/")}
+func isProtected(p string, snap project.Snapshot)bool{return p==".fireweed"||strings.HasPrefix(p,".fireweed/")||matches(stringsValue(snap.Config["protected"]),p)}
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest)[]project.Diagnostic{
+	var out []project.Diagnostic
+	var target *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module{target=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+	check:=func(p,status string){p=path.Clean(strings.TrimPrefix(p,"./"));reject:=func(reason string){out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:p,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s",p,reason)})}
+		if isProtected(p,request.Snapshot){reject("protected path");return}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/") {if p!=path.Clean(request.ChangePath){reject("other change file")};return}
+		if request.Phase=="audit"{reject("audit may edit only current change");return}
+		for _,m:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if inModule(p,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=request.Module{reject("other module");return}}
+		if target==nil||!inModule(p,target.Dir){if !matches(stringsValue(request.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),p){reject("outside worker writable paths")};return}
+		rel:=moduleRelative(p,target.Dir);if rel=="SPEC.md"{reject("module SPEC.md");return}
+		zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+		if request.Phase=="evals" {switch zone {case "protected","preserve","append_only":reject("zone frozen during evals");case "interface":if !request.InterfaceDeclared{reject("interface not declared")};case "disposable":if existsAtBase(request.Snapshot.Root,request.Base,p){reject("existing disposable file")}};return}
+		if request.Phase=="impl" {switch zone{case "protected","evals","interface":reject("zone frozen during impl");case "append_only":if status!="A"||existsAtBase(request.Snapshot.Root,request.Base,p){reject("append-only existing file")}};return}
+		reject("unknown phase")
+	}
+	for _,c:=range request.Changes{if c.OldPath!=""{check(c.OldPath,c.Status)};check(c.Path,c.Status)}
+	return out
+}
+func existsAtBase(root,revision,p string)bool{if revision==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,p);return err==nil}

func Test_CHK_051_CHK_052_SetupFailureStopsAndCleans(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'setup:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\necho failed setup >&2\nexit 17\n", f.log))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
		t.Errorf("setup failure absent: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "eval:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "boundaries:") || strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "worker:") {
		t.Errorf("setup failure ran later probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("scratch worktree leaked: %q", got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
}

func Test_CHK_051_CancellationCleansScratchAndStopsSetupGroup(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
	childFinished := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "child-finished")
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'setup:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
sh -c 'sleep 2; printf finished > "$1"' sh %q &
printf ready > %q
wait
`, f.log, childFinished, ready))
	f.commit()
	before := worktrees(f)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
	go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, f.request(true)) }()
	deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
			break
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case report := <-reports:
			t.Fatalf("setup exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("setup never signalled readiness")
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
	cancel()
	select {
	case report := <-reports:
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "setup") {
			t.Errorf("cancelled setup lacked C14: %s", doctorText(report))
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("cancelled doctor did not return promptly")
	}
	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("cancelled doctor retained Git registration: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	assertScratchRemoved(t, f)
	time.Sleep(2200 * time.Millisecond)
	if _, err := os.Stat(childFinished); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("cancelled setup descendant continued: %v", err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_054_MissingTemplatesAndCanaryMaps(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, body, term, input, affected string }{
		{"missing template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"malformed template", ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "---\nname: [broken\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\n---\n", "template", "SPEC.md", "undeclared"},
		{"missing baseline", ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", "version: 1\nbaseline: {}\n", "canary", "baseline", "undeclared"},

 succeeded in 717ms:
func doctorErrors(report checks.DoctorReport) bool {

}
func doctorLog(f doctorFixture) string { b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.log); return string(b) }

func assertScratchRemoved(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	common := strings.TrimSpace(f.git("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
		common = filepath.Join(f.root, common)
	}
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
	for _, line := range strings.Split(doctorLog(f), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "setup:") {
			continue
		}
		path := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "setup:")
		for parent := path; ; parent = filepath.Dir(parent) {
			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(parent)
			if err == nil {
				suffix, err := filepath.Rel(parent, path)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				path = filepath.Join(resolved, suffix)
				break
			}
			if parent == filepath.Dir(parent) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, path)
		if err != nil || rel == "." || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			t.Errorf("scratch %q is not below common Git directory %q", path, base)
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Errorf("physical scratch directory %q remains or cannot be checked: %v", path, err)
		}
		return
	}
	t.Error("setup did not record a scratch path")
}

func Test_CHK_053_NestedModuleTemplatesRenderForBothCanaries(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)

	eval := string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, ".fireweed/eval.sh")))
	check := fmt.Sprintf(`case "$1" in
  doctor*)
    prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
    other=
    for spec in packages/*/SPEC.md; do
      dir=${spec%%/SPEC.md}
      case "$dir" in packages/alpha|"$2") ;; *) other=$dir ;; esac
    done
    expected="$1|$prefix|$1|example.test/doctorfixture|$2|$other"
    test -n "$other" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/evals/nested.txt")" = "eval|$expected" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/internal/nested.txt")" = "internal|$expected" &&
      test "$(cat "$2/evals/baseline.txt")" = "baseline|$expected" &&
      test ! -e "$2/evals/nested.txt.tmpl" || exit 17
    printf 'rendered:%%s\n' "$1" >> %q
    ;;
esac
`, f.log)
	f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", strings.Replace(eval, "#!/bin/sh\n", "#!/bin/sh\n"+check, 1))

	if doctorErrors(report) {
		t.Errorf("nested template probes failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"baseline", "undeclared", "internal_eval", "failing_eval", "missing_id", "recovery"} {

		}

	if got := worktrees(f); got != before {
		t.Errorf("scratch registration leaked: before %q after %q", before, got)
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "setup:") {
		assertScratchRemoved(t, f)

+package engine
+

+	"strings"
+	"syscall"

+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }
+
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any {
+	if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok { return m }
+	return nil
+}
+func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string {
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []string: return x
+	case []any:
+		out := make([]string, 0, len(x)); for _, v := range x { if s, ok := v.(string); ok { out = append(out,s) } }; return out
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func hook(config map[string]any, name string) any { return mapping(config["hooks"])[name] }
+func moduleHook(module project.Module, name string) any { return mapping(module.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name] }
+
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
+func expandOnce(s string, values map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+	var b strings.Builder
+	for i:=0;i<len(s); {
+		if s[i]=='{' { if j:=strings.IndexByte(s[i:], '}'); j>=0 { key:=s[i+1:i+j]; if value,ok:=values[key];ok { if shell { value=shellQuote(value) }; b.WriteString(value); i+=j+1; continue } } }
+		b.WriteByte(s[i]); i++
+	}
+	return b.String()
+}
+func commandArgs(command any, values map[string]string) ([]string,error) {
+	switch x:=command.(type) {
+	case string:
+		if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook command") }
+		return []string{"sh","-c",expandOnce(x,values,true)},nil
+	case []string:
+		if len(x)==0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv") }; out:=make([]string,len(x)); for i,s:=range x {out[i]=expandOnce(s,values,false)}; return out,nil
+	case []any:
+		if len(x)==0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv") }; out:=make([]string,len(x)); for i,v:=range x { s,ok:=v.(string);if !ok{return nil,fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};out[i]=expandOnce(s,values,false)};return out,nil
+	default: return nil,fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T",command)
+	}
+}
+type processResult struct { stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error }
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, root string, args []string, env map[string]string) processResult {
+	if timeout<=0 { timeout=3*time.Minute }
+	ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout); defer cancel()
+	if len(args)==0 || args[0]=="" { return processResult{err:fmt.Errorf("empty command")} }
+	cmd:=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...);cmd.Dir=root
+	cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+	cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+	var out,errout bytes.Buffer;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+	if err:=cmd.Start();err!=nil{return processResult{err:err}}
+	done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+	var err error
+	select {case err=<-done: case <-ctx.Done(): _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL); <-done;err=ctx.Err()}
+	r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+	if err==nil {return r};if e,ok:=err.(*exec.ExitError);ok {r.exit=e.ExitCode();r.err=nil}
+	return r
+}
+func rootPath(root,p string) string { return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(p)) }

+func readCanaries(root string)(canaryManifest,error){var c canaryManifest;data,err:=os.ReadFile(rootPath(root,".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml"));if err!=nil{return c,err};if err:=yaml.Unmarshal(data,&c);err!=nil{return c,err};if c.Version!=1{return c,fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: version must be 1")};if len(c.Baseline)==0{return c,fmt.Errorf("canary baseline map missing")};return c,nil}

+func makeProbeModules(scratch string,c canaryManifest)([]probeModule,error){template:=rootPath(scratch,".fireweed/templates/module");if _,err:=os.Stat(filepath.Join(template,"SPEC.md"));err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};goModule:="";if data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch,"go.mod"));err==nil{for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(data),"\n"){fields:=strings.Fields(line);if len(fields)==2&&fields[0]=="module"{goModule=fields[1];break}}}
+	var modules []probeModule;names:=[]string{"doctora","doctorb"};for i,name:=range names{dir:="packages/"+name;other:="packages/"+names[1-i];vars:=map[string]string{"name":name,"prefix":strings.ToUpper(name[:3]),"package":name,"go_module":goModule,"module_dir":dir,"other_dir":other};var templateFiles []string;err:=filepath.Walk(template,func(p string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil{return e};if info.Mode().IsRegular(){templateFiles=append(templateFiles,p)};return nil});if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template: %w",err)};for _,p:=range templateFiles{rel,_:=filepath.Rel(template,p);dest:=strings.TrimSuffix(rel,".tmpl");body,err:=os.ReadFile(p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};target:=rootPath(scratch,filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(dir,dest)));if err:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target),0755);err!=nil{return nil,err};if err:=os.WriteFile(target,[]byte(renderCanary(string(body),vars)),0644);err!=nil{return nil,err}};if _,err:=writeMap(scratch,dir,c.Baseline,vars);err!=nil{return nil,err};data,err:=os.ReadFile(rootPath(scratch,dir+"/SPEC.md"));if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};if _,err:=contracts.ParseItems(func()string{s,_:=contracts.Section(doc.Body,"Specs");return s}());err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};modules=append(modules,probeModule{project.Module{Name:name,IDPrefix:vars["prefix"],Dir:dir,Document:doc},vars})};return modules,nil}
+
+func baseline(ctx context.Context,snap project.Snapshot,bin string,timeout time.Duration,modules []project.Module,r *model.DoctorReport,label string)bool{passed:=true;for _,m:=range modules{report,err:=Evaluate(ctx,model.HookRequest{Snapshot:snap,Module:m.Name,Bin:bin,Timeout:timeout});if err==nil{items,e:=moduleSpecs(m);if e!=nil{err=e}else if e=RequireCoverage(report,items);e!=nil{err=e}else{err=RequirePass(report,items)}};ok:=err==nil;doctorCheck(r,label+" eval",m.Name,ok,fmt.Sprint(err));if !ok{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook for %s: %v",label,m.Name,err),m.Dir,false);passed=false}}
+	diags,err:=Boundaries(ctx,model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot:snap,Bin:bin,Timeout:timeout});for _,d:=range diags{if d.Warning || (!d.Warning&&label=="baseline"){r.Diagnostics=append(r.Diagnostics,d)}};ok:=err==nil;doctorCheck(r,label+" boundaries","",ok,fmt.Sprint(err));if !ok{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",label,err),"",false);passed=false};return passed}
+
+func doctorCanary(ctx context.Context,snap project.Snapshot,bin string,timeout time.Duration,p probeModule,name string,files map[string]string,r *model.DoctorReport){if len(files)==0{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s canary map missing",name),".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml",false);doctorCheck(r,name,p.module.Name,false,"missing canary map");return};created,err:=writeMap(snap.Root,p.module.Dir,files,p.vars);if err!=nil{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s canary: %v",name,err),p.module.Dir,false);return};defer func(){for _,file:=range created{_ = os.Remove(file)}}()
+	passed:=false;detail:="";if name=="undeclared"||name=="internal_eval"{diags,err:=Boundaries(ctx,model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot:snap,Bin:bin,Timeout:timeout});for _,d:=range diags{if d.Code!="X01"{continue};line:=strings.ToLower(d.Message);if strings.HasPrefix(line,strings.ToLower(p.module.Name)+":")&&(name=="undeclared"||strings.Contains(line,"interface")){passed=true}};detail=fmt.Sprint(err,diags);if !passed{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundary hook missed canary for %s: %s",name,p.module.Name,detail),p.module.Dir,false)}}else if name=="failing_eval"{report,err:=Evaluate(ctx,model.HookRequest{Snapshot:snap,Module:p.module.Name,Bin:bin,Timeout:timeout});items,_:=moduleSpecs(p.module);for _,item:=range items{for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c,item.ID)&&report.HookExit!=0&&err==nil{passed=true}}};detail=fmt.Sprint(err,report);if !passed{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook missed canary for %s: %s",name,p.module.Name,detail),p.module.Dir,false)}}else{_,err:=Evaluate(ctx,model.HookRequest{Snapshot:snap,Module:p.module.Name,Bin:bin,Timeout:timeout});detail=fmt.Sprint(err);if err!=nil&&strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(),"C11:")&&strings.Contains(err.Error(),"testcase")&&strings.Contains(err.Error(),"known spec ID"){passed=true};if !passed{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook missed canary for %s: %s",name,p.module.Name,detail),p.module.Dir,false)}}
+	doctorCheck(r,name,p.module.Name,passed,detail)
+	for _,file:=range created{_ = os.Remove(file)};created=nil
+	baseline(ctx,snap,bin,timeout,[]project.Module{p.module},r,"recovery "+name)
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bfe7bd235a31373d5a0863433d55b07ec1c15302
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/history.go
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func gitOutput(root string,args ...string)(string,error){cmd:=exec.Command("git",append([]string{"-C",root},args...)...);out,err:=cmd.CombinedOutput();if err!=nil{return "",fmt.Errorf("git %s: %w: %s",strings.Join(args," "),err,strings.TrimSpace(string(out)))};return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)),nil}
+func gitPaths(root,revision string)([]string,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"ls-tree","-r","--name-only",revision);if err!=nil{return nil,err};if out==""{return nil,nil};return strings.Split(out,"\n"),nil}
+func recordedChanges(root,revision string)(map[string]contracts.Document,error){paths,err:=gitPaths(root,revision);if err!=nil{return nil,err};changes:=map[string]contracts.Document{};for _,p:=range paths{if !strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/")||!strings.HasSuffix(p,".md"){continue};data,err:=gitOutput(root,"show",revision+":"+p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(data);if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("%s at %s: %w",p,revision,err)};changes[p]=doc};return changes,nil}
+func changeIdentity(p string)string{return path.Base(p)}
+func priorChange(changes map[string]contracts.Document,p string)(contracts.Document,bool){if doc,ok:=changes[p];ok{return doc,true};for old,doc:=range changes{if changeIdentity(old)==changeIdentity(p){return doc,true}};return contracts.Document{},false}
+func changedPaths(root,parent,commit string)(map[string]string,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"diff","--name-status","-M",parent,commit);if err!=nil{return nil,err};result:=map[string]string{};for _,line:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){parts:=strings.Split(line,"\t");if len(parts)<2{continue};status:=parts[0];if strings.HasPrefix(status,"R")||strings.HasPrefix(status,"C"){if len(parts)>2{result[parts[1]]="D";result[parts[2]]="A"}}else{result[parts[1]]=status}};return result,nil}
+func combinedPaths(root,commit string)(map[string]bool,error){out,err:=gitOutput(root,"show","--cc","--format=","--name-only",commit);if err!=nil{return nil,err};paths:=map[string]bool{};for _,p:=range strings.Split(out,"\n"){if p!=""{paths[p]=true}};return paths,nil}
+func zoneMatches(snap project.Snapshot,p string,selector func(contracts.Zones)[]string)bool{for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if inModule(p,m.Dir)&&matches(selector(m.Zones),moduleRelative(p,m.Dir)){return true}};return false}
+func projectedZones(snap project.Snapshot,change contracts.Document)project.Snapshot{
+	name:=stringValue(change.Frontmatter["module"]);set:=mapping(change.Frontmatter["set"]);if name==""||set==nil{return snap}
+	for i:=range snap.Modules{if snap.Modules[i].Name!=name{continue};z:=&snap.Modules[i].Zones
+		for key,value:=range set{v:=stringsValue(value);switch key{case "evals":z.Evals=v;case "interface":z.Interface=v;case "append_only":z.AppendOnly=v;case "protected":z.Protected=v;case "disposable":z.Disposable=v;case "preserve":z.Preserve=v}}
+	}
+	return snap
+}
+func History(root,revisionRange string)(model.HistoryReport,error){
+	result:=model.HistoryReport{}
+	if revisionRange==""{snap,err:=project.Load(root);if err!=nil{return result,err};base:=stringValue(snap.Config["base"]);if base==""{return result,fmt.Errorf("missing configured base")};resolved,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-parse",base);if err!=nil{return result,err};mergeBase,err:=gitOutput(root,"merge-base","HEAD",resolved);if err!=nil{return result,err};revisionRange=mergeBase+"..HEAD"}
+	list,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--reverse","--topo-order",revisionRange);if err!=nil{return result,err};if list==""{return result,nil};result.Commits=strings.Split(list,"\n")
+	for _,commit:=range result.Commits{
+		line,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-list","--parents","-n","1",commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};parents:=strings.Fields(line)[1:]
+		after,err:=project.LoadAt(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,fmt.Errorf("project at %s: %w",commit,err)}
+		afterChanges,err:=recordedChanges(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+		if len(parents)==0{continue}
+		before,err:=project.LoadAt(root,parents[0]);if err!=nil{return result,fmt.Errorf("project at %s: %w",parents[0],err)}
+		beforeChanges,err:=recordedChanges(root,parents[0]);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+		paths,err:=changedPaths(root,parents[0],commit);if err!=nil{return result,err}
+		if len(parents)>1 {combined,err:=combinedPaths(root,commit);if err!=nil{return result,err};paths=map[string]string{};for p:=range combined{paths[p]="M"}}
+		worker:=false;appliedFromImpl:=false;squashed:=false;projectedBefore:=before;projectedAfter:=after
+		for p,doc:=range afterChanges{
+			phase:=stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]);if phase==""{continue}
+			old,ok:=priorChange(beforeChanges,p);oldPhase:=stringValue(old.Frontmatter["phase"])
+			if len(parents)>1{sameParent:=false;for _,parent:=range parents{pc,err:=recordedChanges(root,parent);if err!=nil{return result,err};if previous,found:=priorChange(pc,p);found&&stringValue(previous.Frontmatter["phase"])==phase{sameParent=true;break}};if sameParent{continue}}
+			if ok&&oldPhase==phase{continue};worker=true
+			if phase=="applied" {if oldPhase=="impl" {appliedFromImpl=true;projectedBefore=projectedZones(projectedBefore,old);projectedAfter=projectedZones(projectedAfter,doc)}else{squashed=true;result.Squashed=append(result.Squashed,model.SquashedChange{Commit:commit,Change:p})}}
+		}
+		add:=func(code,p string){result.Diagnostics=append(result.Diagnostics,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Path:p,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s at %s",code,commit)})}
+		for p,status:=range paths{
+			if worker&&!squashed&&(isProtected(p,before)||isProtected(p,after)||zoneMatches(before,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Protected})||zoneMatches(after,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Protected})||strings.HasPrefix(p,".fireweed/playbooks/")){add("H01",p)}
+			if appliedFromImpl&&!squashed&&(zoneMatches(projectedBefore,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Evals})||zoneMatches(projectedBefore,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Interface})||zoneMatches(projectedAfter,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Evals})||zoneMatches(projectedAfter,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.Interface})){add("H02",p)}
+			if status!="A"&&(zoneMatches(before,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.AppendOnly})||zoneMatches(after,p,func(z contracts.Zones)[]string{return z.AppendOnly})){add("H03",p)}
+			if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/archive/")&&status!="A"&&status!="D"{add("H04",p)}
+		}
+	}
+	return result,nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a6340e56e62ebf8b34bc5f12f330dbdf3887564f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/hooks.go
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func moduleSpecs(module project.Module)([]contracts.Item,error){section,_:=contracts.Section(module.Document.Body,"Specs");items,err:=contracts.ParseItems(section);if err!=nil {message:=err.Error();if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message),"duplicate"){return nil,coded("C05","%s",message)};return nil,coded("C03","%s",message)};return items,nil}
+func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, request model.HookRequest)(model.Report,error){
+	var module *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module{module=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+	if module==nil{return model.Report{},coded("U02","unknown module %q",request.Module)}
+	specs,err:=moduleSpecs(*module);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},err}
+	selected:=moduleHook(*module,"eval");if selected==nil{selected=hook(request.Snapshot.Config,"eval")};if selected==nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","missing eval hook for %s",module.Name)}
+	f,err:=os.CreateTemp("","fireweed-junit-*.xml");if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","create JUnit report: %v",err)};reportPath:=f.Name();f.Close();os.Remove(reportPath);defer os.Remove(reportPath)
+	values:=map[string]string{"module":module.Name,"module_dir":module.Dir,"report":reportPath}
+	args,err:=commandArgs(selected,values);if err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","eval hook: %v",err)}
+	result:=runCommand(ctx,request.Timeout,request.Snapshot.Root,args,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin})
+	report:=model.Report{HookExit:result.exit,Stdout:result.stdout,Stderr:result.stderr}
+	if result.err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","run hook: %v",result.err)}
+	data,err:=os.ReadFile(reportPath);if err!=nil{return report,coded("C11","read JUnit report: %v",err)}
+	parsed,err:=ParseJUnit(data,specs);if err!=nil{return report,err};report.Cases=parsed.Cases;report.Seconds=parsed.Seconds
+	fails:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"{fails=true;break}}
+	if (result.exit==0)==fails{return report,coded("C11","eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures",result.exit)}
+	return report,nil
+}
+
+func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, request model.BoundaryRequest)([]project.Diagnostic,error){
+	snap:=request.Snapshot;var diags []project.Diagnostic;var first error
+	add:=func(code,msg,path string,warning bool){diags=append(diags,project.Diagnostic{Code:code,Message:msg,Path:path,Warning:warning});if !warning&&first==nil{first=coded(code,"%s",msg)}}
+	baseline:=map[string]bool{};if b,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root,".fireweed","boundaries-baseline"));err==nil{for _,line:=range strings.Split(string(b),"\n"){if line!=""{baseline[line]=true}}}
+	optOut:=map[string]string{};for _,m:=range snap.Modules{reason:=strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]));if reason!=""{optOut[m.Name]=reason;add("X03",fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt-out: %s",m.Name,reason),m.Dir,true)}}
+	global:=hook(snap.Config,"boundaries")
+	// The global hook applies to modules without an override; each override is run separately.
+	type group struct{command any; modules []project.Module; label string}
+	groups:=[]group{};var globalModules []project.Module
+	for _,m:=range snap.Modules {if local:=moduleHook(m,"boundaries");local!=nil{groups=append(groups,group{local,[]project.Module{m},m.Name})}else{globalModules=append(globalModules,m)}}
+	if global!=nil && len(globalModules)>0 {groups=append([]group{{global,globalModules,"global"}},groups...)}
+	for _,m:=range globalModules {if global==nil{if len(m.Zones.Disposable)>0&&optOut[m.Name]==""{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s: missing boundaries hook",m.Name),m.Dir,false)}else{add("X04",fmt.Sprintf("%s: no boundary enforcement required",m.Name),m.Dir,true)}}}
+	for _,g:=range groups {
+		values:=map[string]string{};if len(g.modules)==1{values["module"]=g.modules[0].Name;values["module_dir"]=g.modules[0].Dir}
+		args,err:=commandArgs(g.command,values);if err!=nil{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",g.label,err),"",false);continue}
+		r:=runCommand(ctx,request.Timeout,snap.Root,args,map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN":request.Bin})
+		if r.err!=nil{add("X02",fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v",g.label,r.err),"",false);continue}
+		for _,line:=range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr,"\n"),"\n") {line=strings.TrimSpace(line);if line==""||baseline[line]{continue};moduleName:="";for _,m:=range snap.Modules{if strings.HasPrefix(line,m.Name+":"){moduleName=m.Name;break}};if moduleName!=""&&optOut[moduleName]!=""{continue};add("X01",line,"",false)}
+	}
+	return diags,first
+}
+
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d72751e42e0541fc2392bd68e870fdbbb75c5109
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/junit.go
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"encoding/xml"
+	"fmt"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+)
+
+type junitDetail struct { Message string `xml:"message,attr"`; Body string `xml:",chardata"` }
+type junitCase struct { Name string `xml:"name,attr"`; Classname string `xml:"classname,attr"`; Time string `xml:"time,attr"`; Failure []junitDetail `xml:"failure"`; Error []junitDetail `xml:"error"`; Skipped []struct{} `xml:"skipped"` }
+type junitSuite struct { Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`; Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"` }
+type junitDocument struct { XMLName xml.Name; Cases []junitCase `xml:"testcase"`; Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"` }
+
+func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report,error) {
+	var doc junitDocument
+	if err:=xml.Unmarshal(data,&doc);err!=nil{return model.Report{},coded("C11","parse JUnit: %v",err)}
+	if doc.XMLName.Local!="testsuite" && doc.XMLName.Local!="testsuites" {return model.Report{},coded("C11","invalid JUnit root %q",doc.XMLName.Local)}
+	var cases []junitCase;cases=append(cases,doc.Cases...)
+	var collect func(junitSuite);collect=func(s junitSuite){cases=append(cases,s.Cases...);for _,child:=range s.Suites{collect(child)}}
+	for _,suite:=range doc.Suites{collect(suite)}
+	report:=model.Report{}
+	for _,c:=range cases {
+		ids:=[]string{};for _,s:=range specs {if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID,c.Name,c.Classname){ids=append(ids,s.ID)}}
+		if len(ids)==0 {
+			// Distinguish an apparent but unknown ID from a testcase with no ID at all.
+			for _,part:=range strings.FieldsFunc(c.Name+" "+c.Classname,func(r rune)bool{return !(r>='A'&&r<='Z'||r>='a'&&r<='z'||r>='0'&&r<='9'||r=='-'||r=='_')}) {
+				candidate:=strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(part,"_",""))
+				for _,s:=range specs {prefix:=strings.SplitN(s.ID,"-",2)[0];if strings.HasPrefix(candidate,prefix) && len(candidate)>len(prefix) {return model.Report{},coded("C11","testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q",c.Name,part)}}
+			}
+			return model.Report{},coded("C11","testcase %q has no known spec ID",c.Name)
+		}
+		seconds,_:=strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time,64);result:="pass";failure:=""
+		if len(c.Failure)+len(c.Error)>0 {result="fail";var details []string;for _,d:=range append(c.Failure,c.Error...) {if m:=strings.TrimSpace(d.Message);m!=""{details=append(details,m)};if b:=strings.TrimSpace(d.Body);b!=""{details=append(details,b)}};failure=strings.Join(details,"\n") } else if len(c.Skipped)>0 {result="skip"}
+		report.Cases=append(report.Cases,model.Case{Name:c.Name,Classname:c.Classname,IDs:ids,Result:result,Failure:failure,Seconds:seconds});report.Seconds+=seconds
+	}
+	return report,nil
+}
+func hasID(c model.Case,id string) bool {for _,x:=range c.IDs{if x==id{return true}};return false}
+func exempt(tag string)bool {t:=strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag));return t=="review"||strings.HasPrefix(t,"quarantine")}
+func RequireCoverage(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {for _,s:=range specs {if exempt(s.Tag){continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result!="skip"&&hasID(c,s.ID){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("C10","no coverage for %s",s.ID)}};return nil}
+func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report,ids,already []string)error {done:=map[string]bool{};for _,id:=range already{done[id]=true};for _,id:=range ids{if done[id]{continue};ok:=false;for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result=="fail"&&hasID(c,id){ok=true;break}};if !ok{return coded("P2-01","no fail-first case for %s",id)}};return nil}
+func RequirePass(report model.Report,specs []contracts.Item)error {tags:=map[string]string{};for _,s:=range specs{tags[s.ID]=s.Tag};for _,c:=range report.Cases{if c.Result!="fail"{continue};for _,id:=range c.IDs{if tag,ok:=tags[id];ok&&!strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(tag),"quarantine"){return coded("E01","failed case %q for %s: %s",c.Name,id,fmt.Sprint(c.Failure))}}};return nil}
diff --git a/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cb03b9461cbcd24b3eaed28dda6bd96f62241a50
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/zones.go
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"path"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func matches(patterns []string,p string)bool{for _,pattern:=range patterns{if contracts.MatchGlob(pattern,p){return true}};return false}
+func inModule(p,dir string)bool{return p==dir||strings.HasPrefix(p,strings.TrimSuffix(dir,"/")+"/")}
+func moduleRelative(p,dir string)string{return strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(p,dir),"/")}
+func isProtected(p string, snap project.Snapshot)bool{return p==".fireweed"||strings.HasPrefix(p,".fireweed/")||matches(stringsValue(snap.Config["protected"]),p)}
+func Zones(request model.ZoneRequest)[]project.Diagnostic{
+	var out []project.Diagnostic
+	var target *project.Module;for i:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name==request.Module{target=&request.Snapshot.Modules[i];break}}
+	check:=func(p,status string){p=path.Clean(strings.TrimPrefix(p,"./"));reject:=func(reason string){out=append(out,project.Diagnostic{Code:"Z01",Path:p,Message:fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s",p,reason)})}
+		if isProtected(p,request.Snapshot){reject("protected path");return}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(p,"changes/") {if p!=path.Clean(request.ChangePath){reject("other change file")};return}
+		if request.Phase=="audit"{reject("audit may edit only current change");return}
+		for _,m:=range request.Snapshot.Modules{if inModule(p,m.Dir)&&m.Name!=request.Module{reject("other module");return}}
+		if target==nil||!inModule(p,target.Dir){if !matches(stringsValue(request.Snapshot.Config["worker_writable"]),p){reject("outside worker writable paths")};return}
+		rel:=moduleRelative(p,target.Dir);if rel=="SPEC.md"{reject("module SPEC.md");return}
+		zone:=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,target.Zones)
+		if request.Phase=="evals" {switch zone {case "protected","preserve","append_only":reject("zone frozen during evals");case "interface":if !request.InterfaceDeclared{reject("interface not declared")};case "disposable":if existsAtBase(request.Snapshot.Root,request.Base,p){reject("existing disposable file")}};return}
+		if request.Phase=="impl" {switch zone{case "protected","evals","interface":reject("zone frozen during impl");case "append_only":if status!="A"||existsAtBase(request.Snapshot.Root,request.Base,p){reject("append-only existing file")}};return}
+		reject("unknown phase")
+	}
+	for _,c:=range request.Changes{if c.OldPath!=""{check(c.OldPath,c.Status)};check(c.Path,c.Status)}
+	return out
+}
+func existsAtBase(root,revision,p string)bool{if revision==""{return false};_,err:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,revision,p);return err==nil}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..d0897d7320daa10d06c18fd65dc9e16285f8ea5a

+++ b/packages/checks/internal/engine/common.go
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+package engine
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+)
+
+func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }
+
+func mapping(v any) map[string]any {
+	if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok { return m }
+	return nil
+}
+func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
+func stringsValue(v any) []string {
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []string: return x
+	case []any:
+		out := make([]string, 0, len(x)); for _, v := range x { if s, ok := v.(string); ok { out = append(out,s) } }; return out
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func hook(config map[string]any, name string) any { return mapping(config["hooks"])[name] }
+func moduleHook(module project.Module, name string) any { return mapping(module.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name] }
+
+func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
+func expandOnce(s string, values map[string]string, shell bool) string {
+	var b strings.Builder
+	for i:=0;i<len(s); {
+		if s[i]=='{' { if j:=strings.IndexByte(s[i:], '}'); j>=0 { key:=s[i+1:i+j]; if value,ok:=values[key];ok { if shell { value=shellQuote(value) }; b.WriteString(value); i+=j+1; continue } } }
+		b.WriteByte(s[i]); i++
+	}
+	return b.String()
+}
+func commandArgs(command any, values map[string]string) ([]string,error) {
+	switch x:=command.(type) {
+	case string:
+		if strings.TrimSpace(x)=="" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook command") }
+		return []string{"sh","-c",expandOnce(x,values,true)},nil
+	case []string:
+		if len(x)==0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv") }; out:=make([]string,len(x)); for i,s:=range x {out[i]=expandOnce(s,values,false)}; return out,nil
+	case []any:
+		if len(x)==0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv") }; out:=make([]string,len(x)); for i,v:=range x { s,ok:=v.(string);if !ok{return nil,fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")};out[i]=expandOnce(s,values,false)};return out,nil
+	default: return nil,fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T",command)
+	}
+}
+type processResult struct { stdout,stderr string; exit int; err error }
+func runCommand(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, root string, args []string, env map[string]string) processResult {
+	if timeout<=0 { timeout=3*time.Minute }
+	ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(ctx,timeout); defer cancel()
+	if len(args)==0 || args[0]=="" { return processResult{err:fmt.Errorf("empty command")} }
+	cmd:=exec.Command(args[0],args[1:]...);cmd.Dir=root
+	cmd.SysProcAttr=&syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true}
+	cmd.Env=os.Environ();for k,v:=range env {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,k+"="+v)}
+	var out,errout bytes.Buffer;cmd.Stdout=&out;cmd.Stderr=&errout
+	if err:=cmd.Start();err!=nil{return processResult{err:err}}
+	done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-cmd.Wait()}()
+	var err error
+	select {case err=<-done: case <-ctx.Done(): _=syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid,syscall.SIGKILL); <-done;err=ctx.Err()}
+	r:=processResult{stdout:out.String(),stderr:errout.String(),err:err}
+	if err==nil {return r};if e,ok:=err.(*exec.ExitError);ok {r.exit=e.ExitCode();r.err=nil}
+	return r
+}
+func rootPath(root,p string) string { return filepath.Join(root,filepath.FromSlash(p)) }

+func copyCurrent(src,dst string)error{return filepath.Walk(src,func(p string,info os.FileInfo,err error)error{if err!=nil{return err};rel,e:=filepath.Rel(src,p);if e!=nil{return e};if rel=="."{return nil};if rel==".git"||strings.HasPrefix(rel,".git"+string(filepath.Separator)){if info.IsDir(){return filepath.SkipDir};return nil};if rel==filepath.Join(".fireweed","runs")&&info.IsDir(){return filepath.SkipDir};target:=filepath.Join(dst,rel);if info.IsDir(){return os.MkdirAll(target,info.Mode().Perm())};if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink!=0{link,e:=os.Readlink(p);if e!=nil{return e};_ = os.Remove(target);return os.Symlink(link,target)};if !info.Mode().IsRegular(){return nil};if e:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target),0755);e!=nil{return e};in,e:=os.Open(p);if e!=nil{return e};defer in.Close();out,e:=os.OpenFile(target,os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_WRONLY,info.Mode().Perm());if e!=nil{return e};_,e=io.Copy(out,in);closeErr:=out.Close();if e!=nil{return e};return closeErr})}
+func scratchWorktree(root string)(string,string,func(),error){common,err:=gitOutput(root,"rev-parse","--git-common-dir");if err!=nil{return "","",nil,err};if !filepath.IsAbs(common){common=filepath.Join(root,common)};common,err=filepath.EvalSymlinks(common);if err!=nil{return "","",nil,err};base:=filepath.Join(common,"fireweed","worktrees");if err:=os.MkdirAll(base,0755);err!=nil{return "","",nil,err};scratch,err:=os.MkdirTemp(base,"doctor-");if err!=nil{return "","",nil,err};_ = os.Remove(scratch);if _,err=gitOutput(root,"worktree","add","--detach","--force",scratch,"HEAD");err!=nil{_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch);return "","",nil,err};cleanup:=func(){_,_=gitOutput(root,"worktree","remove","--force",scratch);_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch);_,_=gitOutput(root,"worktree","prune")};if err:=copyCurrent(root,scratch);err!=nil{cleanup();return "","",nil,err};return scratch,common,cleanup,nil}

+func guidanceWarnings(root string,r *model.DoctorReport){data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root,"AGENTS.md"));if err!=nil||!strings.Contains(string(data),managedGuidance){doctorAdd(r,"C16","AGENTS.md managed guidance missing or stale","AGENTS.md",true)};files,_:=filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","playbooks","*.md"));for _,p:=range files{name:=strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p),".md");embedded,err:=assets.Playbook(name);if err!=nil{continue};sum:=sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded));want:=hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]);data,readErr:=os.ReadFile(p);base:="";if readErr==nil{if doc,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));e==nil{base=stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"])}};if base!=want{doctorAdd(r,"C16",fmt.Sprintf("%s playbook embedded_base missing or stale",name),p,true)}}}

+type canaryManifest struct {Version int `yaml:"version"`;Baseline map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`;Undeclared map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`;InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`;FailingEval map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`;MissingID map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`}

+	var modules []probeModule;names:=[]string{"doctora","doctorb"};prefixes:=[]string{"DRA","DRB"};for i,name:=range names{dir:="packages/"+name;other:="packages/"+names[1-i];vars:=map[string]string{"name":name,"prefix":prefixes[i],"package":name,"go_module":goModule,"module_dir":dir,"other_dir":other};var templateFiles []string;err:=filepath.Walk(template,func(p string,info os.FileInfo,e error)error{if e!=nil{return e};if info.Mode().IsRegular(){templateFiles=append(templateFiles,p)};return nil});if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template: %w",err)};for _,p:=range templateFiles{rel,_:=filepath.Rel(template,p);dest:=strings.TrimSuffix(rel,".tmpl");body,err:=os.ReadFile(p);if err!=nil{return nil,err};target:=rootPath(scratch,filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(dir,dest)));if err:=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target),0755);err!=nil{return nil,err};if err:=os.WriteFile(target,[]byte(renderCanary(string(body),vars)),0644);err!=nil{return nil,err}};if _,err:=writeMap(scratch,dir,c.Baseline,vars);err!=nil{return nil,err};data,err:=os.ReadFile(rootPath(scratch,dir+"/SPEC.md"));if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};doc,err:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(data));if err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};if _,err:=contracts.ParseItems(func()string{s,_:=contracts.Section(doc.Body,"Specs");return s}());err!=nil{return nil,fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w",err)};modules=append(modules,probeModule{project.Module{Name:name,IDPrefix:vars["prefix"],Dir:dir,Document:doc},vars})};return modules,nil}
+
+func baseline(ctx context.Context,snap project.Snapshot,bin string,timeout time.Duration,modules []project.Module,r *model.DoctorReport,label string)bool{passed:=true;for _,m:=range modules{report,err:=Evaluate(ctx,model.HookRequest{Snapshot:snap,Module:m.Name,Bin:bin,Timeout:timeout});if err==nil{items,e:=moduleSpecs(m);if e!=nil{err=e}else if e=RequireCoverage(report,items);e!=nil{err=e}else{err=RequirePass(report,items)}};ok:=err==nil;doctorCheck(r,label+" eval",m.Name,ok,fmt.Sprint(err));if !ok{doctorAdd(r,"C14",fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook for %s: %v",label,m.Name,err),m.Dir,false);passed=false}}
