package engine

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
const doctorReply = "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
const managedGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"

func doctorAdd(r *model.DoctorReport, code, msg, p string, warning bool) {
	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Path: p, Warning: warning})
}
func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, pass bool, detail string) {
	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: pass, Detail: detail})
}
func hasError(diags []project.Diagnostic) bool {
	for _, d := range diags {
		if !d.Warning {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func copyCurrent(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.Walk(src, func(p string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, e := filepath.Rel(src, p)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if rel == "." {
			return nil
		}
		if rel == ".git" || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".git"+string(filepath.Separator)) {
			if info.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		if rel == filepath.Join(".fireweed", "runs") && info.IsDir() {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if info.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, info.Mode().Perm())
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			link, e := os.Readlink(p)
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			_ = os.Remove(target)
			return os.Symlink(link, target)
		}
		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil
		}
		if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		in, e := os.Open(p)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		defer in.Close()
		out, e := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_WRONLY, info.Mode().Perm())
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		_, e = io.Copy(out, in)
		closeErr := out.Close()
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		return closeErr
	})
}
func scratchWorktree(root string) (string, string, func(), error) {
	common, err := gitOutput(root, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(common) {
		common = filepath.Join(root, common)
	}
	common, err = filepath.EvalSymlinks(common)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	base := filepath.Join(common, "fireweed", "worktrees")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	scratch, err := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	_ = os.Remove(scratch)
	if _, err = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", "--force", scratch, "HEAD"); err != nil {
		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	cleanup := func() {
		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "remove", "--force", scratch)
		_ = os.RemoveAll(scratch)
		_, _ = gitOutput(root, "worktree", "prune")
	}
	if err := copyCurrent(root, scratch); err != nil {
		cleanup()
		return "", "", nil, err
	}
	return scratch, common, cleanup, nil
}

func guidanceWarnings(root string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "AGENTS.md"))
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(data), managedGuidance) {
		doctorAdd(r, "C16", "AGENTS.md managed guidance missing or stale", "AGENTS.md", true)
	}
	files, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "playbooks", "*.md"))
	for _, p := range files {
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(p), ".md")
		embedded, err := assets.Playbook(name)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(embedded))
		want := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(p)
		base := ""
		if readErr == nil {
			if doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data)); e == nil {
				base = stringValue(doc.Frontmatter["embedded_base"])
			}
		}
		if base != want {
			doctorAdd(r, "C16", fmt.Sprintf("%s playbook embedded_base missing or stale", name), p, true)
		}
	}
}

type canaryManifest struct {
	Version      int               `yaml:"version"`
	Baseline     map[string]string `yaml:"baseline"`
	Undeclared   map[string]string `yaml:"undeclared"`
	InternalEval map[string]string `yaml:"internal_eval"`
	FailingEval  map[string]string `yaml:"failing_eval"`
	MissingID    map[string]string `yaml:"missing_id"`
}
type probeModule struct {
	module project.Module
	vars   map[string]string
}

func renderCanary(s string, vars map[string]string) string {
	for _, key := range []string{"name", "prefix", "package", "go_module", "module_dir", "other_dir"} {
		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, "{{"+key+"}}", vars[key])
	}
	return s
}
func readCanaries(root string) (canaryManifest, error) {
	var c canaryManifest
	data, err := os.ReadFile(rootPath(root, ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml"))
	if err != nil {
		return c, err
	}
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &c); err != nil {
		return c, err
	}
	if c.Version != 1 {
		return c, fmt.Errorf("canaries.yaml: version must be 1")
	}
	if len(c.Baseline) == 0 {
		return c, fmt.Errorf("canary baseline map missing")
	}
	return c, nil
}
func writeMap(root, dir string, files map[string]string, vars map[string]string) ([]string, error) {
	var created []string
	for p, body := range files {
		full := rootPath(root, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(dir, p)))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); err != nil {
			return created, err
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, []byte(renderCanary(body, vars)), 0644); err != nil {
			return created, err
		}
		created = append(created, full)
	}
	return created, nil
}
func makeProbeModules(scratch string, c canaryManifest) ([]probeModule, error) {
	template := rootPath(scratch, ".fireweed/templates/module")
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(template, "SPEC.md")); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
	}
	goModule := ""
	if data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(scratch, "go.mod")); err == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
			fields := strings.Fields(line)
			if len(fields) == 2 && fields[0] == "module" {
				goModule = fields[1]
				break
			}
		}
	}
	var modules []probeModule
	stem := fmt.Sprintf("doctor%x", time.Now().UnixNano())
	names := []string{stem + "a", stem + "b"}
	prefixes := []string{"DRA", "DRB"}
	for i, name := range names {
		dir := "packages/" + name
		other := "packages/" + names[1-i]
		vars := map[string]string{"name": name, "prefix": prefixes[i], "package": name, "go_module": goModule, "module_dir": dir, "other_dir": other}
		var templateFiles []string
		err := filepath.Walk(template, func(p string, info os.FileInfo, e error) error {
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if info.Mode().IsRegular() {
				templateFiles = append(templateFiles, p)
			}
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template: %w", err)
		}
		for _, p := range templateFiles {
			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(template, p)
			dest := strings.TrimSuffix(rel, ".tmpl")
			body, err := os.ReadFile(p)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			target := rootPath(scratch, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(dir, dest)))
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if err := os.WriteFile(target, []byte(renderCanary(string(body), vars)), 0644); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		templateSpec, err := os.ReadFile(rootPath(scratch, dir+"/SPEC.md"))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
		}
		if _, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(templateSpec)); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
		}
		if _, err := writeMap(scratch, dir, c.Baseline, vars); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(rootPath(scratch, dir+"/SPEC.md"))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
		}
		doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(string(data))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
		}
		if _, err := contracts.ParseItems(func() string { s, _ := contracts.Section(doc.Body, "Specs"); return s }()); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("module template SPEC.md: %w", err)
		}
		modules = append(modules, probeModule{project.Module{Name: name, IDPrefix: vars["prefix"], Dir: dir, Document: doc}, vars})
	}
	return modules, nil
}

func baseline(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, bin string, timeout time.Duration, modules []project.Module, r *model.DoctorReport, label string) bool {
	passed := true
	for _, m := range modules {
		report, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		if err == nil {
			items, e := moduleSpecs(m)
			if e != nil {
				err = e
			} else if e = RequireCoverage(report, items); e != nil {
				err = e
			} else {
				err = RequirePass(report, items)
			}
		}
		ok := err == nil
		doctorCheck(r, label+" eval", m.Name, ok, fmt.Sprint(err))
		if !ok {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook for %s: %v", label, m.Name, err), m.Dir, false)
			passed = false
		}
	}
	diags, err := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
	for _, d := range diags {
		if d.Warning || (!d.Warning && label == "baseline") {
			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
		}
	}
	ok := err == nil
	doctorCheck(r, label+" boundaries", "", ok, fmt.Sprint(err))
	if !ok {
		doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v", label, err), "", false)
		passed = false
	}
	return passed
}

func doctorCanary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, bin string, timeout time.Duration, p probeModule, name string, files map[string]string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	if len(files) == 0 {
		doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s canary map missing", name), ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", false)
		doctorCheck(r, name, p.module.Name, false, "missing canary map")
		return
	}
	created, err := writeMap(snap.Root, p.module.Dir, files, p.vars)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s canary: %v", name, err), p.module.Dir, false)
		return
	}
	defer func() {
		for _, file := range created {
			_ = os.Remove(file)
		}
	}()
	passed := false
	detail := ""
	wantedIDs := map[string]bool{}
	idPattern := regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+`)
	for _, body := range files {
		for _, id := range idPattern.FindAllString(renderCanary(body, p.vars), -1) {
			wantedIDs[id] = true
		}
	}
	if name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval" {
		diags, err := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		for _, d := range diags {
			if d.Code != "X01" {
				continue
			}
			line := strings.ToLower(d.Message)
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, strings.ToLower(p.module.Name)+":") && (name == "undeclared" || strings.Contains(line, "interface")) {
				passed = true
			}
		}
		detail = fmt.Sprint(err, diags)
		if !passed {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundary hook missed canary for %s: %s", name, p.module.Name, detail), p.module.Dir, false)
		}
	} else if name == "failing_eval" {
		report, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: p.module.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		items, _ := moduleSpecs(p.module)
		for _, item := range items {
			if len(wantedIDs) > 0 && !wantedIDs[item.ID] {
				continue
			}
			for _, c := range report.Cases {
				if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c, item.ID) && report.HookExit != 0 && err == nil {
					passed = true
				}
			}
		}
		detail = fmt.Sprint(err, report)
		if !passed {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook missed canary for %s: %s", name, p.module.Name, detail), p.module.Dir, false)
		}
	} else {
		_, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: p.module.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		detail = fmt.Sprint(err)
		if err != nil && strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "C11:") && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "testcase") && (strings.Contains(err.Error(), "known spec ID") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unknown spec ID")) {
			for id := range wantedIDs {
				if strings.Contains(err.Error(), id) {
					passed = true
				}
			}
		}
		if !passed {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook missed canary for %s: %s", name, p.module.Name, detail), p.module.Dir, false)
		}
	}
	doctorCheck(r, name, p.module.Name, passed, detail)
	for _, file := range created {
		_ = os.Remove(file)
	}
	created = nil
	baseline(ctx, snap, bin, timeout, []project.Module{p.module}, r, "recovery "+name)
}

func addProbeModuleConfig(root string, probes []probeModule) error {
	p := filepath.Join(root, "fireweed.yaml")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var config map[string]any
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	mods := stringsValue(config["modules"])
	for _, probe := range probes {
		found := false
		for _, pattern := range mods {
			if contracts.MatchGlob(pattern, probe.module.Dir) {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			mods = append(mods, probe.module.Dir)
		}
	}
	config["modules"] = mods
	data, err = yaml.Marshal(config)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(p, data, 0644)
}

func finalLines(output string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n"), "\n")
	if len(lines) > 20 {
		lines = lines[len(lines)-20:]
	}
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}
func commandTemplateUses(v any, placeholder string) bool {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case string:
		return strings.Contains(x, placeholder)
	case []string:
		for _, s := range x {
			if strings.Contains(s, placeholder) {
				return true
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, item := range x {
			if s, ok := item.(string); ok && strings.Contains(s, placeholder) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
func agentProbe(ctx context.Context, request model.DoctorRequest, scratch, common, runDir, role string, command, wrapper any, config map[string]any, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	logPath := filepath.Join(runDir, "doctor-"+role+"-1.log")
	values := map[string]string{"prompt": doctorPrompt, "git_common_dir": common}
	if commandTemplateUses(command, "{prompt_file}") || commandTemplateUses(wrapper, "{prompt_file}") {
		file, err := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-doctor-prompt-")
		if err != nil {
			doctorAdd(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s prompt file: %v", role, err), "", false)
			return
		}
		values["prompt_file"] = file.Name()
		_, _ = file.WriteString(doctorPrompt)
		_ = file.Close()
		defer os.Remove(file.Name())
	}
	args, err := commandArgs(command, values)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s command: %v", role, err), "", false)
		doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, "log: "+logPath)
		_ = os.WriteFile(logPath, nil, 0644)
		return
	}
	commandText := strings.Join(args, " ")
	if wrapper != nil {
		if shell, ok := wrapper.(string); ok {
			args = append([]string{"sh", "-c", expandOnce(shell, values, true) + " \"$@\"", "fireweed-wrapper"}, args...)
		} else {
			wrapArgs, e := commandArgs(wrapper, values)
			if e != nil {
				err = e
			} else {
				args = append(wrapArgs, args...)
			}
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("%s wrapper: %v", role, err), "", false)
		doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, "log: "+logPath)
		_ = os.WriteFile(logPath, nil, 0644)
		return
	}
	output := runCommand(ctx, request.Timeout, scratch, args, nil)
	full := output.stdout + output.stderr
	_ = os.WriteFile(logPath, []byte(full), 0644)
	passed := output.err == nil && output.exit == 0
	reply := false
	for _, line := range strings.Split(output.stdout, "\n") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(line) == doctorReply {
			reply = true
			break
		}
	}
	passed = passed && reply
	detail := fmt.Sprintf("command: %s; log: %s", commandText, logPath)
	if passed {
		doctorCheck(r, role, "", true, detail)
		return
	}
	tail := finalLines(output.combined)
	reason := fmt.Sprintf("%s command %s failed (exit %d): %v\n%s", role, commandText, output.exit, output.err, tail)
	for _, pattern := range stringsValue(config["limit_patterns"]) {
		if pattern != "" && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(tail), strings.ToLower(pattern)) {
			reason = "usage limit: " + reason
			break
		}
	}
	doctorAdd(r, "C15", reason, "", false)
	doctorCheck(r, role, "", false, detail+"\n"+tail)
}

func Doctor(ctx context.Context, request model.DoctorRequest) model.DoctorReport {
	r := model.DoctorReport{}
	root, err := filepath.Abs(request.Root)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("project root: %v", err), request.Root, false)
		return r
	}
	request.Root = root
	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Check(root)...)
	guidanceWarnings(root, &r)
	if hasError(r.Diagnostics) {
		return r
	}
	scratch, common, cleanup, err := scratchWorktree(root)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("scratch worktree: %v", err), "", false)
		return r
	}
	defer cleanup()
	snapshot, err := project.Load(scratch)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("load scratch project: %v", err), "", false)
		return r
	}
	if setup := hook(snapshot.Config, "setup"); setup != nil {
		args, e := commandArgs(setup, nil)
		if e != nil {
			doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("setup hook: %v", e), "", false)
			return r
		}
		result := runCommand(ctx, request.Timeout, scratch, args, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin})
		if result.err != nil || result.exit != 0 {
			doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("setup hook failed: %v exit %d %s %s", result.err, result.exit, result.stdout, result.stderr), "", false)
			return r
		}
		doctorCheck(&r, "setup", "", true, "setup hook")
	}
	manifest, err := readCanaries(scratch)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("canary canaries.yaml: %v", err), ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", false)
		return r
	}
	probes, err := makeProbeModules(scratch, manifest)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("module template or canary: %v", err), ".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", false)
		return r
	}
	if err := addProbeModuleConfig(scratch, probes); err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("canary module config: %v", err), "fireweed.yaml", false)
		return r
	}
	snapshot, err = project.Load(scratch)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("load canary modules: %v", err), "", false)
		return r
	}
	// A project may enforce boundaries exclusively through module overrides.
	// Use an applicable override for generated canaries when no global hook exists.
	var boundaryFallback, evalFallback any
	for _, m := range snapshot.Modules {
		if m.Name == probes[0].module.Name || m.Name == probes[1].module.Name {
			continue
		}
		if boundaryFallback == nil {
			boundaryFallback = moduleHook(m, "boundaries")
		}
		if evalFallback == nil {
			evalFallback = moduleHook(m, "eval")
		}
	}
	for i := range snapshot.Modules {
		m := &snapshot.Modules[i]
		if m.Name != probes[0].module.Name && m.Name != probes[1].module.Name {
			continue
		}
		hooks := mapping(m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])
		if hooks == nil {
			hooks = map[string]any{}
			m.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"] = hooks
		}
		if hook(snapshot.Config, "boundaries") == nil {
			if boundaryFallback != nil {
				hooks["boundaries"] = boundaryFallback
			} else {
				m.Zones.Disposable = nil
			}
		}
		if hook(snapshot.Config, "eval") == nil && evalFallback != nil {
			hooks["eval"] = evalFallback
		}
	}
	for i := range probes {
		for _, m := range snapshot.Modules {
			if m.Name == probes[i].module.Name {
				probes[i].module = m
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if !baseline(ctx, snapshot, request.Bin, request.Timeout, snapshot.Modules, &r, "baseline") {
		for _, name := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval"} {
			doctorAdd(&r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook skipped after baseline failure", name), "", false)
		}
		return r
	}
	// Probe both generated modules and every real override. The baseline runs every real hook.
	selected := append([]probeModule(nil), probes...)
	for _, m := range snapshot.Modules {
		if m.Name == probes[0].module.Name || m.Name == probes[1].module.Name {
			continue
		}
		if moduleHook(m, "eval") != nil || moduleHook(m, "boundaries") != nil {
			vars := map[string]string{"name": m.Name, "prefix": m.IDPrefix, "package": m.Name, "module_dir": m.Dir, "other_dir": probes[0].module.Dir}
			selected = append(selected, probeModule{m, vars})
		}
	}
	for _, p := range selected {
		for _, entry := range []struct {
			name  string
			files map[string]string
		}{{"undeclared", manifest.Undeclared}, {"internal_eval", manifest.InternalEval}, {"failing_eval", manifest.FailingEval}, {"missing_id", manifest.MissingID}} {
			if (entry.name == "undeclared" || entry.name == "internal_eval") && moduleHook(p.module, "boundaries") == nil && hook(snapshot.Config, "boundaries") == nil {
				continue
			}
			doctorCanary(ctx, snapshot, request.Bin, request.Timeout, p, entry.name, entry.files, &r)
		}
	}
	if request.NoAgent {
		return r
	}
	agent := mapping(snapshot.Config["agent"])
	audit := mapping(snapshot.Config["audit"])
	workerCommand := agent["command"]
	auditCommand := audit["command"]
	if auditCommand == nil {
		auditCommand = workerCommand
		doctorAdd(&r, "C15", "worker and audit share agent.command; shared-command blind spot", "", true)
	}
	base := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(base, 0755); err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("agent log directory: %v", err), base, false)
		return r
	}
	runDir, err := os.MkdirTemp(base, "doctor-")
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(&r, "C15", fmt.Sprintf("agent run directory: %v", err), base, false)
		return r
	}
	// Keep the run directory and logs for the caller, while scratch is removed.
	agentProbe(ctx, request, scratch, common, runDir, "worker", workerCommand, agent["wrap"], snapshot.Config, &r)
	agentProbe(ctx, request, scratch, common, runDir, "audit", auditCommand, agent["wrap"], snapshot.Config, &r)
	return r
}

package engine

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"

func moduleSpecs(module project.Module) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
	section, _ := contracts.Section(module.Document.Body, "Specs")
	items, err := contracts.ParseItems(section)
	if err != nil {
		message := err.Error()
		message = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(message, "C03: "), "C05: ")
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message), "duplicate") {
			return nil, coded("C05", "%s", message)
		}
		return nil, coded("C03", "%s", message)
	}
	return items, nil
}
func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, request model.HookRequest) (model.Report, error) {
	var module *project.Module
	for i := range request.Snapshot.Modules {
		if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name == request.Module {
			module = &request.Snapshot.Modules[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if module == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("U02", "unknown module %q", request.Module)
	}
	specs, err := moduleSpecs(*module)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, err
	}
	selected := moduleHook(*module, "eval")
	if selected == nil {
		selected = hook(request.Snapshot.Config, "eval")
	}
	if selected == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "missing eval hook for %s", module.Name)
	}
	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-junit-*.xml")
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "create JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	reportPath := f.Name()
	f.Close()
	os.Remove(reportPath)
	defer os.Remove(reportPath)
	values := map[string]string{"module": module.Name, "module_dir": module.Dir, "report": reportPath}
	args, err := commandArgs(selected, values)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "eval hook: %v", err)
	}
	result := runCommand(ctx, request.Timeout, request.Snapshot.Root, args, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin})
	report := model.Report{HookExit: result.exit, Stdout: result.stdout, Stderr: result.stderr}
	if result.err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "run hook: %v", result.err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(reportPath)
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "read JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	parsed, err := ParseJUnit(data, specs)
	if err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	report.Cases = parsed.Cases
	report.Seconds = parsed.Seconds
	fails := false
	for _, c := range report.Cases {
		if c.Result == "fail" {
			fails = true
			break
		}
	}
	if (result.exit == 0) == fails {
		return report, coded("C11", "eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures", result.exit)
	}
	return report, nil
}

func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, request model.BoundaryRequest) ([]project.Diagnostic, error) {
	snap := request.Snapshot
	var diags []project.Diagnostic
	var first error
	add := func(code, msg, path string, warning bool) {
		diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Path: path, Warning: warning})
		if !warning && first == nil {
			first = coded(code, "%s", msg)
		}
	}
	baseline := map[string]bool{}
	if b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root, ".fireweed", "boundaries-baseline")); err == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
			if line != "" {
				baseline[line] = true
			}
		}
	}
	optOut := map[string]string{}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		reason := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]))
		if reason != "" {
			optOut[m.Name] = reason
			add("X03", fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt-out: %s", m.Name, reason), m.Dir, true)
		}
	}
	global := hook(snap.Config, "boundaries")
	// The global hook applies to modules without an override; each override is run separately.
	type group struct {
		command any
		modules []project.Module
		label   string
	}
	groups := []group{}
	var globalModules []project.Module
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if local := moduleHook(m, "boundaries"); local != nil {
			groups = append(groups, group{local, []project.Module{m}, m.Name})
		} else {
			globalModules = append(globalModules, m)
		}
	}
	if global != nil && len(globalModules) > 0 {
		groups = append([]group{{global, globalModules, "global"}}, groups...)
	}
	for _, m := range globalModules {
		if global == nil {
			if len(m.Zones.Disposable) > 0 && optOut[m.Name] == "" {
				add("X02", fmt.Sprintf("%s: missing boundaries hook", m.Name), m.Dir, false)
			} else {
				add("X04", fmt.Sprintf("%s: no boundary enforcement required", m.Name), m.Dir, true)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, g := range groups {
		values := map[string]string{}
		if len(g.modules) == 1 {
			values["module"] = g.modules[0].Name
			values["module_dir"] = g.modules[0].Dir
		}
		args, err := commandArgs(g.command, values)
		if err != nil {
			add("X02", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v", g.label, err), "", false)
			continue
		}
		r := runCommand(ctx, request.Timeout, snap.Root, args, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin})
		if r.err != nil {
			add("X02", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v", g.label, r.err), "", false)
			continue
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr, "\n"), "\n") {
			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" || baseline[line] {
				continue
			}
			moduleName := ""
			for _, m := range snap.Modules {
				if strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") {
					moduleName = m.Name
					break
				}
			}
			if moduleName != "" && optOut[moduleName] != "" {
				continue
			}
			add("X01", line, "", false)
		}
	}
	return diags, first
}
package engine

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
)

func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}

func mapping(v any) map[string]any {
	if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
		return m
	}
	return nil
}
func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
func stringsValue(v any) []string {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case []string:
		return x
	case []any:
		out := make([]string, 0, len(x))
		for _, v := range x {
			if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
				out = append(out, s)
			}
		}
		return out
	}
	return nil
}
func hook(config map[string]any, name string) any { return mapping(config["hooks"])[name] }
func moduleHook(module project.Module, name string) any {
	return mapping(module.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name]
}

func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
func expandOnce(s string, values map[string]string, shell bool) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for i := 0; i < len(s); {
		if s[i] == '{' {
			if j := strings.IndexByte(s[i:], '}'); j >= 0 {
				key := s[i+1 : i+j]
				if value, ok := values[key]; ok {
					if shell {
						value = shellQuote(value)
					}
					b.WriteString(value)
					i += j + 1
					continue
				}
			}
		}
		b.WriteByte(s[i])
		i++
	}
	return b.String()
}
func commandArgs(command any, values map[string]string) ([]string, error) {
	switch x := command.(type) {
	case string:
		if strings.TrimSpace(x) == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook command")
		}
		return []string{"sh", "-c", expandOnce(x, values, true)}, nil
	case []string:
		if len(x) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")
		}
		out := make([]string, len(x))
		for i, s := range x {
			out[i] = expandOnce(s, values, false)
		}
		return out, nil
	case []any:
		if len(x) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")
		}
		out := make([]string, len(x))
		for i, v := range x {
			s, ok := v.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")
			}
			out[i] = expandOnce(s, values, false)
		}
		return out, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T", command)
	}
}

type processResult struct {
	stdout, stderr, combined string
	exit                     int
	err                      error
}
type captureWriter struct {
	mu            *sync.Mutex
	own, combined *bytes.Buffer
}

func (w captureWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	_, _ = w.combined.Write(p)
	return w.own.Write(p)
}

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, root string, args []string, env map[string]string) processResult {
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 3 * time.Minute
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	if len(args) == 0 || args[0] == "" {
		return processResult{err: fmt.Errorf("empty command")}
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(args[0], args[1:]...)
	cmd.Dir = root
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	for k, v := range env {
		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, k+"="+v)
	}
	var out, errout, combined bytes.Buffer
	var mu sync.Mutex
	cmd.Stdout = captureWriter{&mu, &out, &combined}
	cmd.Stderr = captureWriter{&mu, &errout, &combined}
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return processResult{err: err}
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
	var err error
	select {
	case err = <-done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
		<-done
		err = ctx.Err()
	}
	r := processResult{stdout: out.String(), stderr: errout.String(), combined: combined.String(), err: err}
	if err == nil {
		return r
	}
	if e, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
		r.exit = e.ExitCode()
		r.err = nil
	}
	return r
}
func rootPath(root, p string) string { return filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(p)) }

func doctorText(report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("checks=%+v diagnostics=%+v", report.Checks, report.Diagnostics)
}
func hasDoctorDiagnostic(report checks.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, terms ...string) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code != code || d.Warning != warning {
			continue
		}
		ok := true
		for _, s := range terms {
			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), strings.ToLower(s)) {
				ok = false
			}
		}
		if ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func hasDoctorCheck(report checks.DoctorReport, name string, passed bool) bool {
	for _, c := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(c.Name, name) && c.Passed == passed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorErrors(report checks.DoctorReport) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

import (

func moduleSpecs(module project.Module) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
	section, _ := contracts.Section(module.Document.Body, "Specs")
	items, err := contracts.ParseItems(section)
	if err != nil {
		message := err.Error()
		message = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(message, "C03: "), "C05: ")
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(message), "duplicate") {
			return nil, coded("C05", "%s", message)
		}
		return nil, coded("C03", "%s", message)
	}
	return items, nil
}
func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, request model.HookRequest) (model.Report, error) {
	var module *project.Module
	for i := range request.Snapshot.Modules {
		if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name == request.Module {
			module = &request.Snapshot.Modules[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if module == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("U02", "unknown module %q", request.Module)
	}
	specs, err := moduleSpecs(*module)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, err
	}
	selected := moduleHook(*module, "eval")
	if selected == nil {
		selected = hook(request.Snapshot.Config, "eval")
	}
	if selected == nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "missing eval hook for %s", module.Name)
	}
	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-junit-*.xml")
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "create JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	reportPath := f.Name()
	f.Close()
	os.Remove(reportPath)
	defer os.Remove(reportPath)
	values := map[string]string{"module": module.Name, "module_dir": module.Dir, "report": reportPath}
	args, err := commandArgs(selected, values)
	if err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "eval hook: %v", err)
	}
	result := runCommand(ctx, request.Timeout, request.Snapshot.Root, args, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin})
	report := model.Report{HookExit: result.exit, Stdout: result.stdout, Stderr: result.stderr}
	if result.err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "run hook: %v", result.err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(reportPath)
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "read JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	parsed, err := ParseJUnit(data, specs)
	if err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	report.Cases = parsed.Cases
	report.Seconds = parsed.Seconds
	fails := false
	for _, c := range report.Cases {
		if c.Result == "fail" {
			fails = true
			break
		}
	}
	if (result.exit == 0) == fails {
		return report, coded("C11", "eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures", result.exit)
	}
	return report, nil
}

func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, request model.BoundaryRequest) ([]project.Diagnostic, error) {
	snap := request.Snapshot
	var diags []project.Diagnostic
	var first error
	add := func(code, msg, path string, warning bool) {
		diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Path: path, Warning: warning})
		if !warning && first == nil {
			first = coded(code, "%s", msg)
		}
	}
	baseline := map[string]bool{}
	if b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(snap.Root, ".fireweed", "boundaries-baseline")); err == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
			if line != "" {
				baseline[line] = true
			}
		}
	}
	optOut := map[string]string{}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		reason := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]))
		if reason != "" {
			optOut[m.Name] = reason
			add("X03", fmt.Sprintf("%s: boundaries opt-out: %s", m.Name, reason), m.Dir, true)
		}
	}
	global := hook(snap.Config, "boundaries")
	// The global hook applies to modules without an override; each override is run separately.
	type group struct {
		command any
		modules []project.Module
		label   string
	}
	groups := []group{}
	var globalModules []project.Module
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if local := moduleHook(m, "boundaries"); local != nil {
			groups = append(groups, group{local, []project.Module{m}, m.Name})
		} else {
			globalModules = append(globalModules, m)
		}
	}
	if global != nil && len(globalModules) > 0 {
		groups = append([]group{{global, globalModules, "global"}}, groups...)
	}
	for _, m := range globalModules {
		if global == nil {
			if len(m.Zones.Disposable) > 0 && optOut[m.Name] == "" {
				add("X02", fmt.Sprintf("%s: missing boundaries hook", m.Name), m.Dir, false)
			} else {
				add("X04", fmt.Sprintf("%s: no boundary enforcement required", m.Name), m.Dir, true)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, g := range groups {
		values := map[string]string{}
		if len(g.modules) == 1 {
			values["module"] = g.modules[0].Name
			values["module_dir"] = g.modules[0].Dir
		}
		args, err := commandArgs(g.command, values)
		if err != nil {
			add("X02", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v", g.label, err), "", false)
			continue
		}
		r := runCommand(ctx, request.Timeout, snap.Root, args, map[string]string{"FIREWEED_BIN": request.Bin})
		if r.err != nil {
			add("X02", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v", g.label, r.err), "", false)
			continue
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(r.stdout+"\n"+r.stderr, "\n"), "\n") {
			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" || baseline[line] {
				continue
			}
			moduleName := ""
			for _, m := range snap.Modules {
				if strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") {
					moduleName = m.Name
					break
				}
			}
			if moduleName != "" && optOut[moduleName] != "" {
				continue
			}
			add("X01", line, "", false)
		}
	}
	return diags, first
}

package engine

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
)

func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}

func mapping(v any) map[string]any {
	if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
		return m
	}
	return nil
}
func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
func stringsValue(v any) []string {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case []string:
		return x
	case []any:
		out := make([]string, 0, len(x))
		for _, v := range x {
			if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
				out = append(out, s)
			}
		}
		return out
	}
	return nil
}
func hook(config map[string]any, name string) any { return mapping(config["hooks"])[name] }
func moduleHook(module project.Module, name string) any {
	return mapping(module.Document.Frontmatter["hooks"])[name]
}

func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
func expandOnce(s string, values map[string]string, shell bool) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for i := 0; i < len(s); {
		if s[i] == '{' {
			if j := strings.IndexByte(s[i:], '}'); j >= 0 {
				key := s[i+1 : i+j]
				if value, ok := values[key]; ok {
					if shell {
						value = shellQuote(value)
					}
					b.WriteString(value)
					i += j + 1
					continue
				}
			}
		}
		b.WriteByte(s[i])
		i++
	}
	return b.String()
}
func commandArgs(command any, values map[string]string) ([]string, error) {
	switch x := command.(type) {
	case string:
		if strings.TrimSpace(x) == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook command")
		}
		return []string{"sh", "-c", expandOnce(x, values, true)}, nil
	case []string:
		if len(x) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")
		}
		out := make([]string, len(x))
		for i, s := range x {
			out[i] = expandOnce(s, values, false)
		}
		return out, nil
	case []any:
		if len(x) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty hook argv")
		}
		out := make([]string, len(x))
		for i, v := range x {
			s, ok := v.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("hook argv contains non-string")
			}
			out[i] = expandOnce(s, values, false)
		}
		return out, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T", command)
	}
}

type processResult struct {
	stdout, stderr, combined string
	exit                     int
	err                      error
}
type captureWriter struct {
	mu            *sync.Mutex
	own, combined *bytes.Buffer
}

func (w captureWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	_, _ = w.combined.Write(p)
	return w.own.Write(p)
}

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, timeout time.Duration, root string, args []string, env map[string]string) processResult {
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 3 * time.Minute
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	if len(args) == 0 || args[0] == "" {
		return processResult{err: fmt.Errorf("empty command")}
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(args[0], args[1:]...)
	cmd.Dir = root
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	for k, v := range env {
		cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, k+"="+v)
	}
	var out, errout, combined bytes.Buffer
	var mu sync.Mutex
	cmd.Stdout = captureWriter{&mu, &out, &combined}
	cmd.Stderr = captureWriter{&mu, &errout, &combined}
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return processResult{err: err}
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
	var err error
	select {
	case err = <-done:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
		<-done
		err = ctx.Err()
	}
	r := processResult{stdout: out.String(), stderr: errout.String(), combined: combined.String(), err: err}
	if err == nil {
		return r
	}
	if e, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError); ok {
		r.exit = e.ExitCode()
		r.err = nil
	}
	return r
}
func rootPath(root, p string) string { return filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(p)) }

func Test_CHK_055_CHK_058_CHK_059_EvalEvidenceIsSpecific(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, script, canary string }{
		{"missing baseline coverage", `#!/bin/sh
printf '<testsuite/>' > "$3"
`, "baseline"},
		{"failing eval compile error without report", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/failing.txt"; then echo 'compile error' >&2; exit 2; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"failing eval with unrelated failure", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/failing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="ALP-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' > "$3"; exit 1; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"missing id with unrelated failure", `#!/bin/sh
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"; exit 1; fi
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "missing_id"},
		{"missing id without report", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then echo 'hook failed' >&2; exit 2; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "missing_id"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", tc.script)
			if tc.name == "missing baseline coverage" {
				logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
			}
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, tc.canary, "eval") {
				t.Errorf("unrelated eval outcome accepted: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
			if tc.name == "missing baseline coverage" && !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "probe:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline coverage hook did not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
			if tc.name == "missing baseline coverage" && strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline coverage continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_055_BaselineAndRecoveryFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, script, phase, hook string }{
		{"baseline eval failure", ".fireweed/eval.sh", "#!/bin/sh\necho baseline-eval-failed >&2\nexit 9\n", "baseline", "eval"},
		{"baseline boundary failure", ".fireweed/boundary.sh", "#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'alpha: baseline violation\\n'\n", "baseline", "boundar"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			f.put(tc.path, tc.script)
			logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, tc.phase, tc.hook) {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline accepted: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
			if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "probe:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline hook did not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
			if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
		})
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, failure string }{
		{"recovery eval failure", "echo recovery-eval-failed >&2; exit 9"},
		{"recovery coverage failure", "printf '<testsuite/>' > \"$3\"; exit 0"},
	f.commit()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "X02", false, "alpha", "boundar") {
		t.Errorf("required boundary hook was not diagnosed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, "baseline", "boundar") {
		t.Errorf("missing boundary hook was accepted as a clean baseline: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
		t.Errorf("missing baseline boundary hook continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	for _, canary := range []string{"undeclared", "internal_eval"} {
		if hasDoctorCheck(report, canary, true) {
			t.Errorf("missing boundary hook counted as %s detection: %s", canary, doctorText(report))
		}
		if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C14", false, canary, "boundar") {
			t.Errorf("missing boundary hook lacked named %s canary failure: %s", canary, doctorText(report))
		}
	}
}

func Test_CHK_055_MissingRequiredHookBesideOverride(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) { delete(config["hooks"].(map[string]any), "boundaries") })
	f.put(".fireweed/override-boundary.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'override-boundaries:%%s\\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\nexec sh .fireweed/boundary.sh\n", f.log))
	f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", strings.Replace(string(mustRead(t, filepath.Join(f.root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md"))), "depends_on: []", "depends_on: []\nhooks:\n  boundaries: sh .fireweed/override-boundary.sh", 1))
	f.put("packages/beta/SPEC.md", "---\nname: beta\nid_prefix: BET\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# Beta\n\n## Specs\n\n### BET-001\nThe fixture MUST pass.\n")
	f.put("packages/beta/internal/live.txt", "disposable implementation\n")
	logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
	f.commit()
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "X02", false, "beta", "boundar") {
		t.Errorf("module without its own hook escaped required boundary enforcement: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
		t.Errorf("failed baseline beside override continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
	if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "override-boundaries:") {
		t.Errorf("applicable override was not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
	}
}

package engine

import (
	"encoding/xml"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
)

type junitDetail struct {
	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
}
type junitCase struct {
	Name      string        `xml:"name,attr"`
	Classname string        `xml:"classname,attr"`
	Time      string        `xml:"time,attr"`
	Failure   []junitDetail `xml:"failure"`
	Error     []junitDetail `xml:"error"`
	Skipped   []struct{}    `xml:"skipped"`
}
type junitSuite struct {
	Cases  []junitCase  `xml:"testcase"`
	Suites []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`
}
type junitDocument struct {
	XMLName xml.Name
	Cases   []junitCase  `xml:"testcase"`
	Suites  []junitSuite `xml:"testsuite"`
}

func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
	var doc junitDocument
	if err := xml.Unmarshal(data, &doc); err != nil {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
	}
	if doc.XMLName.Local != "testsuite" && doc.XMLName.Local != "testsuites" {
		return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", doc.XMLName.Local)
	}
	var cases []junitCase
	cases = append(cases, doc.Cases...)
	var collect func(junitSuite)
	collect = func(s junitSuite) {
		cases = append(cases, s.Cases...)
		for _, child := range s.Suites {
			collect(child)
		}
	}
	for _, suite := range doc.Suites {
		collect(suite)
	}
	report := model.Report{}
	known := map[string]bool{}
	prefixes := map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range specs {
		known[strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(item.ID, "-", ""), "_", ""))] = true
		prefixes[strings.ToUpper(strings.SplitN(item.ID, "-", 2)[0])] = true
	}
	idLike := regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]+`)
	for _, c := range cases {
		for _, token := range idLike.FindAllString(c.Name+" "+c.Classname, -1) {
			canonical := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(token, "-", ""), "_", ""))
			for prefix := range prefixes {
				if strings.HasPrefix(canonical, prefix) && len(canonical) > len(prefix) && !known[canonical] {
					return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, token)
				}
			}
		}
		ids := []string{}
		for _, s := range specs {
			if contracts.MatchesID(s.ID, c.Name, c.Classname) {
				ids = append(ids, s.ID)
			}
		}
		if len(ids) == 0 {
			// Distinguish an apparent but unknown ID from a testcase with no ID at all.
			for _, part := range strings.FieldsFunc(c.Name+" "+c.Classname, func(r rune) bool {
				return !(r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '_')
			}) {
				candidate := strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(part, "_", ""))
				for _, s := range specs {
					prefix := strings.SplitN(s.ID, "-", 2)[0]
					if strings.HasPrefix(candidate, prefix) && len(candidate) > len(prefix) {
						return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, part)
					}
				}
			}
			return model.Report{}, coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
		}
		seconds, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(c.Time, 64)
		result := "pass"
		failure := ""
		if len(c.Failure)+len(c.Error) > 0 {
			result = "fail"
			var details []string
			for _, d := range append(c.Failure, c.Error...) {
				if m := strings.TrimSpace(d.Message); m != "" {
					details = append(details, m)
				}
				if b := strings.TrimSpace(d.Body); b != "" {
					details = append(details, b)
				}
			}
			failure = strings.Join(details, "\n")
		} else if len(c.Skipped) > 0 {
			result = "skip"
		}
		report.Cases = append(report.Cases, model.Case{Name: c.Name, Classname: c.Classname, IDs: ids, Result: result, Failure: failure, Seconds: seconds})
		report.Seconds += seconds
	}
	return report, nil
}
func hasID(c model.Case, id string) bool {
	for _, x := range c.IDs {
		if x == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func exempt(tag string) bool {
	t := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
	return t == "review" || strings.HasPrefix(t, "quarantine")
}
func RequireCoverage(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
	for _, s := range specs {
		if exempt(s.Tag) {
			continue
		}
		ok := false
		for _, c := range report.Cases {
			if c.Result != "skip" && hasID(c, s.ID) {
				ok = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !ok {
			return coded("C10", "no coverage for %s", s.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report, ids, already []string) error {
	done := map[string]bool{}
	for _, id := range already {
		done[id] = true
	}
	for _, id := range ids {
		if done[id] {
			continue
		}
		ok := false
		for _, c := range report.Cases {
			if (c.Result == "fail" || c.Result == "error") && hasID(c, id) {
				ok = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !ok {
			return coded("P2-01", "no fail-first case for %s", id)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func RequirePass(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
	tags := map[string]string{}
	for _, s := range specs {
		tags[s.ID] = s.Tag
	}
	for _, c := range report.Cases {
		if c.Result != "fail" && c.Result != "error" {
			continue
		}
		for _, id := range c.IDs {
			if tag, ok := tags[id]; ok && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(tag), "quarantine") {
				return coded("E01", "failed case %q for %s: %s", c.Name, id, fmt.Sprint(c.Failure))
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func Test_CHK_043_LaunchCancellationAndTimeoutStayErrors(t *testing.T) {
	snap := boundarySnapshot(t, nil)
	snap.Modules[0].Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"] = "legacy"
	snap.Config["hooks"] = map[string]any{"boundaries": []any{filepath.Join(snap.Root, "missing-executable")}}
	diags, err := checks.Boundaries(context.Background(), checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Timeout: time.Second})
	if !boundaryHasError(diags, err) {
		t.Error("launch failure hidden by opt-out")
	}
	if err == nil {
		t.Error("launch failure returned no error")
	}
	requireBoundaryDiagnostic(t, diags, "X02", false, "")
	snap.Config["hooks"] = map[string]any{"boundaries": boundaryScript(t, snap.Root, `sleep 2`)}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	diags, err = checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Timeout: time.Second})
	if !boundaryHasError(diags, err) {
		t.Error("cancelled hook hidden by opt-out")
	}
	if err == nil {
		t.Error("cancelled hook returned no error")
	}
	requireBoundaryDiagnostic(t, diags, "X02", false, "")
	start := time.Now()
	diags, err = checks.Boundaries(context.Background(), checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Timeout: 80 * time.Millisecond})
	if !boundaryHasError(diags, err) {
		t.Error("timed-out hook hidden by opt-out")
	}
	if err == nil {
		t.Error("timed-out hook returned no error")
	}
	requireBoundaryDiagnostic(t, diags, "X02", false, "")
	if time.Since(start) > 3*time.Second {
		t.Error("boundary timeout did not bound execution")
	}
}

+package engine
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const doctorPrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const doctorReply = "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"
+const managedGuidance = "<!-- fireweed:start -->\nThis project uses fireweed. Specs and change files are the source of truth.\nRun `fireweed playbook author-change` before authoring changes and\n`fireweed context <change>` before each step.\n<!-- fireweed:end -->\n"
+
+func doctorAdd(r *model.DoctorReport, code, msg, p string, warning bool) {
+	r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: code, Message: msg, Path: p, Warning: warning})
+}
+func doctorCheck(r *model.DoctorReport, name, module string, pass bool, detail string) {
+	r.Checks = append(r.Checks, model.DoctorCheck{Name: name, Module: module, Passed: pass, Detail: detail})
+}
+func hasError(diags []project.Diagnostic) bool {
+	for _, d := range diags {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}

	defaulted.commit()
	defaultRequest := defaulted.request(false)
	defaultRequest.Timeout = 0
	defaultReport := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), defaultRequest)
	if doctorErrors(defaultReport) || !hasDoctorCheck(defaultReport, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(defaultReport, "audit", true) {

		t.Errorf("NoAgent skipped hooks or ran agent: %s; log=%s", doctorText(skip), doctorLog(j))

func Test_CHK_065_UnsetTimeoutBoundsAuditProbe(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
package evals_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
)

const doctorProbePrompt = "Reply with exactly FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK"

func doctorRecordedPath(t *testing.T, log, label string) string {
	t.Helper()
	return doctorRecordedPaths(t, log, label, 1)[0]
}

func doctorRecordedPaths(t *testing.T, log, label string, count int) []string {
	t.Helper()
	var paths []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(log, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, label+":") {
			paths = append(paths, strings.TrimPrefix(line, label+":"))
		}
	}
	if len(paths) != count {
		t.Fatalf("%s paths = %q; want %d absolute paths", label, paths, count)
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			t.Fatalf("%s path = %q; want an absolute path", label, path)
		}
	}
	return paths
}

func doctorPromptFileRemoved(t *testing.T, path string) {
	t.Helper()
	if _, err := os.Stat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Errorf("prompt file %q remains after probe: %v", path, err)
	}
}

func Test_CHK_082_CHK_083_DoctorExpandsSelectedCommandsAndWrapperOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := localDoctorFixture(t)
	f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) {
		config["agent"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/agent.sh", "pre{prompt}post", "file={prompt_file}", "common={git_common_dir}", "literal {unknown}"}
		config["audit"].(map[string]any)["command"] = "bash .fireweed/audit.sh {prompt} {prompt_file} {git_common_dir}"
		config["agent"].(map[string]any)["wrap"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", "{prompt_file}", "{prompt}", "{git_common_dir}"}
	})
	f.put(".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
printf 'wrap-file:%%s\nwrap-prompt:%%s\nwrap-common:%%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> %q
test -f "$1" && printf '%%s' "$2" | cmp -s - "$1" || exit 11
shift 3
exec "$@"
`, f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
printf 'worker-prompt:%%s\nworker-file:%%s\nworker-common:%%s\nworker-literal:%%s\n' "$1" "${2#file=}" "${3#common=}" "$4" >> %q
test "$1" = "pre%spost" || exit 12
test "$2" != "file=" || exit 13
test -f "${2#file=}" && printf '%%s' %q | cmp -s - "${2#file=}" || exit 14
printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'
`, f.log, doctorProbePrompt, doctorProbePrompt))
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/bash
printf 'audit-prompt:%%s\naudit-file:%%s\naudit-common:%%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> %q
test -f "$2" && printf '%%s' "$1" | cmp -s - "$2" || exit 15
printf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\n'
`, f.log))
	f.commit()
	// Relocate the Git directory so its absolute path contains a quote, a space,
	// and another placeholder. The expanded value must remain literal.
	commonDir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "space 'quote' {prompt}", "repo.git")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(commonDir), 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(filepath.Join(f.root, ".git"), commonDir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(f.root, ".git"), []byte("gitdir: "+commonDir+"\n"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Setenv("TMPDIR", filepath.Dir(commonDir))
	status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
	report := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(false))
	if doctorErrors(report) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", true) || !hasDoctorCheck(report, "audit", true) {
		t.Errorf("prompt-file probes failed: %s", doctorText(report))
	}
	log := doctorLog(f)
	common, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(commonDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{
		"worker-prompt:pre" + doctorProbePrompt + "post", "audit-prompt:" + doctorProbePrompt,
		"worker-common:" + common, "audit-common:" + common,
		"worker-literal:literal {unknown}",
		"wrap-prompt:" + doctorProbePrompt, "wrap-common:" + common,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(log, want+"\n") {
			t.Errorf("missing exact argument %q", want)
		}
	}
	workerFile := doctorRecordedPath(t, log, "worker-file")
	auditFile := doctorRecordedPath(t, log, "audit-file")
	if workerFile == auditFile {
		t.Errorf("worker and audit reused prompt file %q", workerFile)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{workerFile, auditFile} {
		if !strings.Contains(log, "wrap-file:"+path+"\n") {
			t.Errorf("wrapper did not receive selected probe file %q", path)
		}
		doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
	}
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "audit", "FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK")
	doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
}

func Test_CHK_083_DoctorRemovesPromptFileOnProbeFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"launch", "nonzero", "timeout", "cancel"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			ready := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ready")
			f.editConfig(func(config map[string]any) {
				config["agent"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/agent.sh", "{prompt_file}"}
				if mode == "launch" {
					config["agent"].(map[string]any)["command"] = []any{filepath.Join(f.root, "missing-agent"), "{prompt_file}"}
					config["agent"].(map[string]any)["wrap"] = []any{"bash", ".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", "{prompt_file}"}
				}
			})
			f.put(".fireweed/prompt-wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker-file:%%s\\n' \"$1\" >> %q\ntest -f \"$1\" || exit 11\nshift\nexec \"$@\"\n", f.log))
			script := fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker-file:%%s\\nworker-content:%%s\\n' \"$1\" \"$(cat \"$1\")\" >> %q\ntest -f \"$1\" && printf '%%s' %q | cmp -s - \"$1\" || exit 18\nprintf ready > %q\n", f.log, doctorProbePrompt, ready)
			switch mode {
			case "nonzero":
				script += "printf 'failed worker stderr\\n' >&2\nexit 7\n"
			case "timeout", "cancel":
				script += "printf 'waiting worker stdout\\n'\nsleep 5\n"
			}
			f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", script)
			f.commit()
			status, registrations := f.git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"), worktrees(f)
			req := f.request(false)
			if mode == "timeout" {
				req.Timeout = 2 * time.Second
			}
			ctx := context.Background()
			var cancel context.CancelFunc
			if mode == "cancel" {
				ctx, cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
				defer cancel()
			}
			var report checks.DoctorReport
			if mode == "cancel" {
				reports := make(chan checks.DoctorReport, 1)
				go func() { reports <- checks.Doctor(ctx, req) }()
				deadline := time.After(8 * time.Second)
				for {
					if _, err := os.Stat(ready); err == nil {
						break
					} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					select {
					case report = <-reports:
						t.Fatalf("worker exited before cancellation: %s", doctorText(report))
					case <-deadline:
						t.Fatal("worker never signalled readiness")
					case <-time.After(10 * time.Millisecond):
					}
				}
				livePath := doctorRecordedPath(t, doctorLog(f), "worker-file")
				if data, err := os.ReadFile(livePath); err != nil || string(data) != doctorProbePrompt {
					t.Errorf("prompt file unavailable before cancellation: %q, %v", data, err)
				}
				cancel()
				select {
				case report = <-reports:
				case <-time.After(4 * time.Second):
					t.Fatal("cancelled Doctor did not return")
				}
			} else {
				report = checks.Doctor(ctx, req)
			}
			if !hasDoctorCheck(report, "worker", false) || !hasDoctorDiagnostic(report, "C15", false, "worker") {
				t.Errorf("%s probe outcome changed: %s", mode, doctorText(report))
			}
			log := doctorLog(f)
			count := 1
			if mode == "launch" {
				// The shared wrapper records both the failed worker launch and
				// the subsequent audit probe; both files must be cleaned up.
				count = 2
			}
			paths := doctorRecordedPaths(t, log, "worker-file", count)
			if mode != "launch" && !strings.Contains(log, "worker-content:"+doctorProbePrompt+"\n") {
				t.Errorf("%s worker could not read exact prompt: %q", mode, log)
			}
			for _, path := range paths {
				doctorPromptFileRemoved(t, path)
			}
			doctorProbeLog(t, f, report, "worker")
			doctorCallerClean(t, f, status, registrations)
		})
	}
}

	passed := true
	checkLabel := label
	if strings.HasPrefix(label, "recovery ") {
		checkLabel = "recovery"
	}
	for _, m := range modules {
		report, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: m.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		if err == nil {
			items, e := moduleSpecs(m)
			if e != nil {
				err = e
			} else {
				// The throwaway modules carry the canary baseline. Existing modules
				// may have no evals yet, but their hooks must still run cleanly.
				if generated[m.Name] || moduleHook(m, "eval") != nil || len(report.Cases) > 0 {
					err = RequireCoverage(report, items)
				}
				if err == nil {
					err = RequirePass(report, items)
				}
			}
		}
		ok := err == nil
		doctorCheck(r, checkLabel+" eval", m.Name, ok, fmt.Sprint(err))
		if !ok {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook for %s: %v", label, m.Name, err), m.Dir, false)
			passed = false
		}
	}
	diags, err := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: snap, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
	for _, d := range diags {
		if d.Warning || (!d.Warning && label == "baseline") {
			r.Diagnostics = append(r.Diagnostics, d)
		}
	}
	ok := err == nil
	doctorCheck(r, checkLabel+" boundaries", "", ok, fmt.Sprint(err))
	if !ok {
		doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundaries hook: %v", label, err), "", false)
		passed = false
	}
	return passed
}

func doctorCanary(ctx context.Context, snap project.Snapshot, bin string, timeout time.Duration, p probeModule, name string, files map[string]string, r *model.DoctorReport) {
	if len(files) == 0 {
		doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s canary map missing", name), ".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", false)
		doctorCheck(r, name, p.module.Name, false, "missing canary map")
		return
	}
	created, err := writeMap(snap.Root, p.module.Dir, files, p.vars)
	if err != nil {
		doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s canary: %v", name, err), p.module.Dir, false)
		return
	}
	defer func() {
		for _, file := range created {
			_ = os.Remove(file)
		}
	}()
	passed := false
	detail := ""
	wantedIDs := map[string]bool{}
	idPattern := regexp.MustCompile(`[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*[-_][0-9]+`)
	testPattern := regexp.MustCompile(`Test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+`)
	for _, body := range files {
		rendered := renderCanary(body, p.vars)
		for _, id := range idPattern.FindAllString(rendered, -1) {
			wantedIDs[strings.ReplaceAll(id, "_", "-")] = true
		}
		for _, name := range testPattern.FindAllString(rendered, -1) {
			wantedIDs[name] = true
		}
	}
	if name == "undeclared" || name == "internal_eval" {
		boundarySnap := snap
		if moduleHook(p.module, "boundaries") != nil {
			// Isolate this override so a working global hook cannot hide it.
			boundarySnap.Modules = []project.Module{p.module}
		}
		diags, err := Boundaries(ctx, model.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: boundarySnap, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		for _, d := range diags {
			if d.Code != "X01" {
				continue
			}
			line := strings.ToLower(d.Message)
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, strings.ToLower(p.module.Name)+":") && (name == "undeclared" || strings.Contains(line, "interface")) {
				passed = true
			}
		}
		detail = fmt.Sprint(err, diags)
		if !passed {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s boundary hook missed canary for %s: %s", name, p.module.Name, detail), p.module.Dir, false)
		}
	} else if name == "failing_eval" {
		report, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: p.module.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		items, _ := moduleSpecs(p.module)
		for _, item := range items {
			if len(wantedIDs) > 0 && !wantedIDs[item.ID] {
				continue
			}
			for _, c := range report.Cases {
				if c.Result == "fail" && hasID(c, item.ID) && report.HookExit != 0 && err == nil {
					passed = true
				}
			}
		}
		detail = fmt.Sprint(err, report)
		if !passed {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook missed canary for %s: %s", name, p.module.Name, detail), p.module.Dir, false)
		}
	} else {
		_, err := Evaluate(ctx, model.HookRequest{Snapshot: snap, Module: p.module.Name, Bin: bin, Timeout: timeout})
		detail = fmt.Sprint(err)
		if err != nil && strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "C11:") && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "testcase") && (strings.Contains(err.Error(), "known spec ID") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unknown spec ID")) {
			for id := range wantedIDs {
				if strings.Contains(err.Error(), id) {
					passed = true
				}
			}
		}
		if !passed {
			doctorAdd(r, "C14", fmt.Sprintf("%s eval hook missed canary for %s: %s", name, p.module.Name, detail), p.module.Dir, false)
		}
	}
	doctorCheck(r, name, p.module.Name, passed, detail)
	for _, file := range created {
		_ = os.Remove(file)
	}
	created = nil
	baseline(ctx, snap, bin, timeout, []project.Module{p.module}, r, "recovery "+name, map[string]bool{p.module.Name: p.generated})
}
